notes.title: Operation: Plague Star 2025
notes.content:
Prepare to stave off infection, Tenno. [b]Operation: Plague Star is live until September 24 at 11 a.m. ET![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/55ce4e3cf9b1d6838b2c1778ad90d75f797f3d33.png[/img]
Following the impact of an Infested meteorite, a pustulating boil now resides within the Plains of Eidolon. You must take it out before it reaches Cetus! While Councilor Vay Hek is in possession of a toxin that can destroy the boil, he has no intention of lending any aid, so you must acquire the toxin before this infestation grows out of control.
[hr][/hr]
[h3]What You Need To Do[/h3]

Speak to Konzu in Cetus to undertake the Plague Star Bounty

Complete the series of Bounty Missions to earn Operational Supply Standing for the Event Rewards

[h3]What You Need To Know[/h3]

Bounties come with various requirements for completion that yield specific Rewards outlined below.

[h4]Tier 1:[/h4]
[b]Requirements:[/b] No prerequisites
[b]Rewards:[/b]
Base Standing: 1025
Bounty Bonus Completion: 25

[h4]Tier 2:[/h4]
[b]Requirements:[/b] 1x Eidolon Phylaxis + 1x Infested Catalyst
[b]Rewards:[/b]
Base Standing: 3200
Bounty Bonus Completion: 75

[h4]Tier 3:[/h4]
[b]Requirements:[/b]1x Eidolon Phylaxis + 1x Infested Catalyst + Steel Path Eligibility
[b]Rewards:[/b]
Base Standing: 3800
Bounty Bonus Completion: 100

[hr][/hr]
[h3]New Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/e42ffe5af1107f61b6b42f38c6d57eac5d4bd6a0.png[/img]
[list][*]Hemocyte Glyph

[*]1x Omni Forma available to buy

[*]Aspirus Ephemera
[*]Cryptanaut Necramech Helmet
[*]Earth Console
[*]Murex Console[/list]

notes.title: Dog Days 2025 Captura Contest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/658223bc47b3820309c9ddce8ea704c936f6f715.png[/img]
Shell-ebrate good vibes with the Dog Days 2025 Captura Contest! Grab your best buds or dive solo into our Dog Days Captura Scene for a chance to win Caliban Prime Access and some Platinum.

[h3]How to Enter:[/h3]

Share a Dog Days-inspired Captura in the Contest Thread on the [url="https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1465907-dog-days-2025-captura-contest/"]Official Forums[/url] that showcases one to four Warframes enjoying their fresh summer Accessories. Bonus points for incorporating the new Noodletron Hammer Skin!

[h3]How to access the Dog Days Captura Scene:[/h3]

Find Dog Days in the [b]Event tab[/b] at the top right corner of your navigation. Jump in and play through the missions. Once you’ve acquired 490 Nakak Pearls, head to Cetus on Earth and find Nakak. Check out her new offerings and trade your Pearls for the Dog Days Scene!

Once you have the scene, head to the Arsenal > camera icon in the top right > Dog Days Scene/Dog Days Night Scene. That’s it!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Need an Example?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/500a315f7bd2ad52435996905743a6c1039bee9d.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Prizes:[/h3]
[list][*]1st Place: Caliban Prime Access
[*]2nd Place: 1000 Platinum + Didyma Ephemera
[*]3rd Place: 750 Platinum + Didyma Ephemera
[*]4th Place: 600 Platinum + Didyma Ephemera
[*]5th Place: 500 Platinum + Didyma Ephemera[/list]
[h3]Official Contest Rules:[/h3]
[list][*]One submission per player
[*]Submission must be your original work
[*]We do not accept AI-generated images
[*]Do not reserve spots in the official contest thread
[*]Submissions must be images, no videos please!
[*]Winners will be chosen based on the [b]creativity[/b] and [b]quality[/b] of the image.
[*]Submissions will be subject to further review by Digital Extremes. Work-In-Progress must be prepared and is required to win. Please attach WIP with your post or send to [de]ronnie on the forums. Videos, timelapses, screenshots/ photos capturing your process, Captura settings are examples of acceptable forms of WIP. [/list]
The submission period for this contest ends on August 27. We'll announce the winners on September 4 during Prime Time, starting at 6 p.m. ET over at [url="https://www.twitch.tv/warframe"]twitch.tv/warframe[/url]. Seas the day, Tenno!

notes.title: Dog Days 2025
notes.content:
Get ready to soak up the sun and partake in a seaside scrimmage to remember as Dog Days is now live!
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/35892cf6faf69e2b421385807ad17ee746b41c2a.png[/img]
[h3]Event Changes[/h3]
Your favorite excuse to soak up the sun is also making waves with significant changes that will make this year’s Event more accessible than ever. 
[list][*]Many returning items in Nakak’s shop for Nakak Pearls will receive discounts [*]You can sort Nakak Pearl offerings by item name, latest additions and price
[*]Several adjustments made to the Soaktron, including increased clip size, rate of fire, projectile range and improvements to reloading! The Soaktron also has a standard ammo pool now, meaning you do not need to replenish it at refill stations and comes equipped with the "perfect reload" mechanic that can speed up reload time if timed correctly
[*]Lob Blobs have a higher damage output and damage radius[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Floaty of Fury Alerts[/h3]
Special weekend Alerts will appear throughout August and will be held within the Star Chart, outside of the Dog Days node, and as an additional way to earn some Nakak Pearls: 
[list][*]Aug. 7 - 11: Crossfire Exterminate (Mercury) - 175 Nakak Pearls + 50K Credits
[*]Aug. 14 - 18: Mobile Defense (Deimos) - 175 Nakak Pearls + 50K Credits
[*]Aug. 21 - 25: Sabotage (Mars) - 175 Nakak Pearls + 50K Credits
[*]Aug. 28 - Sept. 1: Shrine Defense (Earth) - 175 Nakak Pearls + 50K Credits[/list]
[b]Please note:[/b] This is the first time we’ve held an Alert on the Shrine Defense node! The alert will be visible but not functional, in the World State Window even if you don’t have the node unlocked. Unlocking the node will allow you to play the Alert!

You'll also enjoy more beachside flair during Floaty of Fury Alerts and Dog Days Alerts, as the Noodletron Hammer itself will override melee weapons for all players within the event for fun! 
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Dog Days Missions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/128535d4551edbc19a863ea6d3c771fd528d19ce.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Alert 1:[/b] Hydroid Community Glyph + 50K Credits (25 Nakak Pearls first completion, 10 Pearls subsequent runs)
[*][b]Alert 2:[/b] Loki Community Glyph + 50K Credits (50 Nakak Pearls first completion, 20 Pearls subsequent runs)
[*][b]Alert 3:[/b] Nova Community Glyph + 50K Credits (75 Nakak Pearls first completion, 30 Pearls subsequent runs)
[*][b]Bonus Alert 4:[/b] Valkyr Community Glyph + 50K Credits (100 Nakak Pearls + 2 per kill first completion, 30 Pearls + rewards per kill subsequent runs)[/list]
[b]Please note:[/b] replaying Mission 4 earns you Nakak Pearls for each enemy you soak to smithereens, and now also for assists.
[hr][/hr]
[h3]New Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/658223bc47b3820309c9ddce8ea704c936f6f715.png[/img]
Furthermore, there will be several all-new goodies available from Nakak’s store in exchange for Nakak Pearls, including:

[list][*][b]Noodletron Hammer Skin:[/b] Boop enemies with this vicious tube of embarrassment that can be used with any hammer and celebrate Dog Days all year round. WARNING: Not a floatation device.[*][b]Community Dog Days Glyphs:[/b] These Glyphs featuring Hydroid, Loki, Valkyr, and Nova were created by community artist [url="https://x.com/ChickenDraws"]ChickenDrawsDogs![/url][*][b]Aqua Heart Emblem:[/b] Cool off with this unique emblem.[*][b]Splashdown Sigil:[/b] Refresh yourself with this unique sigil.[*][b]Marshlands Color Palette:[/b] Unlocks additional color options for Warframe customization.[*][b]Dog Days Flow Emote:[/b] Demonstrate control and flow with this fluid emote.[*][b]Dog Days “Hang Loose” Poster:[/b] Ride the waves with Yareli. Beverage not included.[/list]

Returning items like the Roller Floofs, Dog Days Ephemera, Soaktron Rifle Skin and loads more will also be available at Nakak’s store.

Keep an eye out for details on a special Dog Days-themed contest arriving soon. Until then, we’ll see you surfside, Tenno!

notes.title: The Devil's Triad Revealed
notes.content:
[i][b]Something fallen has found its way to you, Tenno.[/b][/i]

In the wake of an infamous luminary on his path toward absolution, a trio of new figures — both divine and damned — will debut later this year to consecrate The Old Peace.

Behold their hallowed presence for yourself by gazing into the righteous fires of our TennoLive reveal:

[previewyoutube=JvtNg1pM2oc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]NEW PROTOFRAMES[/h2]

[h3]Father Lyon Allard (Harrow)[/h3]
Recognizable by his righteous thurible, Father Lyon is visited by both terrible evil and visions of a future that needs him.

[h3]Marie Leroux (Wisp)[/h3]
Carried by her devotion, the faithful Marie is put to the test with a profane and unexpected emergence…

[h2]NEW WARFRAME: URIEL[/h2]
A devilish Warframe rises from the flames of perdition. Condemned to torment, his return begs of the Origin System questions of forgiveness and redemption.

[hr][/hr]
Learn more about The Old Peace, as revealed during TennoLive 2025 [url=https://www.warframe.com/the-old-peace]here.[/url]

notes.title: “Lullaby of the Manifold” Official Music Release
notes.content:
This year's TennoLive demo swept viewers away to the cratered wastelands of The Old War. Though [i]heavily[/i] punctuated by weapons-fire and explosions (even by traditional Warframe standards), one surprising musical element offered a distinctly serene reprieve from the horrors of conflict on ancient Tau.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/6bc1684bb72638bfaf80559c768f1245fd49d503.png[/img]
Sung in-game by a new character named Adis to calm and restore his fellow Sentients, "Lullaby of the Manifold" is now available to enjoy for your own solace on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/playwarframe]Official Warframe YouTube Channel[/url]. If you haven't yet heard this sweeping orchestral arrangement for yourself, check out our Music Video below:

[previewyoutube=yPKo04oNQ9k;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
Created in-house by our talented team of artists and collaborators (many of whom performed during TennoConcert 2025), this indelible new track is also available to enjoy on your streaming platform of choice.

notes.title: TennoCon 2025 Recap
notes.content:
That's a wrap on TennoCon 2025! We can't thank you enough for joining us for the 10th annual TennoCon. Whether you watched from home or were with us in person, this day was all about you: our community. 

In case you missed it, or want to relive the biggest moments from our 10th TennoCon, you can watch the TennoConcert and full TennoLive VODs now on YouTube! 

[h1]THE OLD PEACE[/h1]

[h2]Awaken the Past[/h2]

[previewyoutube=bfoypaVNGuU;full][/previewyoutube]
Unearth a forgotten chapter of Warframe in 2025. The Tau system awaits you in 2026.

[h1]TennoCon 2025 Gameplay Demo [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/0114e081c647d58868bc41d3fc4dbf246f954208.png[/img]
The Old Peace thrusts you into a period of unification between the Sentients and Orokin as you navigate a bloodsoaked conflict against the Dax Anarchs with your Sentient ally, Adis. Told in increments as you delve into memories long thought lost, only you can relive the truth of The Old Peace.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/live/FSqwET8-P-Q?si=lszdshGDOQfp-A75&t=24502]Watch now.[/url]

[h2]Lullaby of the Manifold[/h2]

[previewyoutube=yPKo04oNQ9k;full][/previewyoutube]
Immerse yourself in the somber, heartfelt tone of The Old Peace with "Lullaby of the Manifold" and enjoy a brief moment of peace as you prepare to dive into the fires of war. The full "Lullaby of the Manifold" song is now available for listening on our official YouTube channel!

[h2]In Remembrance of Tau[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/9e77301f1dc5d1ec412c0216df1628f4c4e363e1.png[/img]
This historical exhibit commemorates the halcyon days of Tau, the unsteady peace of the past, as well as Orokin arrogance. Get a look at all the details for yourself!

[h2]The Devil's Triad[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/3a7d0a04594d0063b30d718ad07eb1812a1d72ab.png[/img]
A new Warframe and two new Protoframes (Harrow and Wisp) will also arrive with The Old Peace in 2025. 

Come face to face with a devilish new Warframe, Uriel, and continue onto the trail of Albrecht Entrati in a new side story: The Devil's Triad. Can the Orokin ever be forgiven? Someone searches for an answer.

[h2]Operator Remaster & Tauron Focus Expansion[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/408bd320471ae6eb0be63623086ffbab77bbe14b.jpg[/img]
A long-awaited Operator Remaster is coming with The Old Peace, bringing updated visual fidelity across all Operators. Get your first look at an updated Operator in the full Gameplay Demo!

Rediscover what Focus meant during the peak of Orokin power as you master Tauron Focus. You have only witnessed a drop of what these new abilities entail, Tenno. The crucible of The Old Peace may require you to release the flood.

[h1]COMING SOON[/h1]

[h2]Tau 2026[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/14dcd1558214aa45725885102c24ee7655a994d2.png[/img]
The Old Peace propels Warframe's next cinematic story arc into motion, setting the stage for your monumental voyage to the Tau system in 2026, a first for Warframe. 

[h2]Unannounced Fall 2025 Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/bc25423fd37e2e7d400bc2247a22d1febd80242b.png[/img]Before The Old Peace arrives later this year, you can first look forward to another update this fall! This update will feature a new Warframe, a rework for Oberon, a new tutorial Quest geared towards teaching new players the fundamentals of the Mod system to increase the power of your Warframes and Weapons, and new customizations like a Lavos Deluxe Skin.

Learn more during our next Devstream on September 25!

[h2]Caliban Prime Access[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/fadd5d2a2b2695448393b6343b5bbc4b13588452.png[/img]
A hybrid of Warframe and Sentient, bestowed with Orokin gold. Caliban Prime will enter Prime Access alongside his signature Weapons and exclusive new Customizations soon!

[url=https://www.warframe.com/news/caliban-prime-access-first-look]Learn more.[/url]

[h2]Warframe x Starfinder: Operation Orias[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/f1257e61040b021581ba763b9b24fb13ed35dcc3.jpg[/img]
In collaboration with Paizo, we're bringing Warframe to the tabletop! Warframe x Starfinder: Operation Orias will release this October. If you're headed to GenCon this year, you can experience a small snippet of this adventure for yourself at the Paizo booth!

[url=https://paizo.com/starfinder/warframe]Learn more.[/url]

[h2]Android Closed Beta[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/814debd3230d070fe6c80888d90988cd4c64bb7f.png[/img]
Get your mobile devices ready, Tenno! The Origin System arrives in your pocket when the Warframe Android Closed Beta begins this fall!

Make sure you're ready for mobile Missions by [url=https://www.warframe.com/android]opting in to our Closed Beta[/url] and check out our FAQ for more information.

[h1]SOULFRAME[/h1]

[h2]Gameplay Spotlight[/h2]

[previewyoutube=LufEwRrZHdM;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]"We bear seeds for you that show the future…"[/i]

Through a copse of trees and Mendicant reanimated corpses, see what's to come in the future of Soulframe Preludes!

[h2]TennoCon 2025 Gameplay[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/cf39abc2b0dc3b334c084de1685c36a318d7586d.jpg[/img]
Delve deep into the nature of the Neath'uns and get a glimpse into the tale of the Arbearer Bromius.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4l3AMSDUTI4]Watch now.[/url]

[h2]Soulframe Devstream 8[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/a9a7723175f5324264a1d0543833f92a07363873.jpg[/img]
The Soulframe team took to the stage to share an update on Soulframe: Preludes! 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4AsivzS57xA]Learn more.[/url]

[h2]TennoCon 2025 Preludes Access[/h2]

For a limited time, any players interested in joining Soulframe in its pre-alpha, Preludes state can get instant access!

[url=https://www.soulframe.com/en]Join Preludes now.[/url]

[h1]EVENTS[/h1]

[h2]TennoVIP Tour[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/776be6bd3277d6e555b4a7771216e6394eb10333.png[/img]
The Warframe team is going on tour! With stops in London (England), Cologne, Tokyo, and Calgary, you can come hang out with fellow Tenno and Warframe developers around the globe.

You can sign up for TennoVIP UK and TennoVIP EU on their respective Eventbrite pages now, with tickets going live on Friday, July 25, 2025 at 2 p.m. ET.

[h2]Dog Days Summer Event[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/35892cf6faf69e2b421385807ad17ee746b41c2a.png[/img]
Your favorite summer event returns this August.

Dog Days is back on August 6, packed with the same summer fun you love, along with new rewards. Earn festive community Glyphs crafted by ChickenDrawsDogs and a pool noodle-inspired Hammer Weapon Skin!

Plus, we've updated the signature Soaktron & Lob Blobs and lowered the Nakak Pearl cost for more rewards and maximum fun!

Get ready to make a splash on August 6 with Dog Days!

[h1]PACKS & MERCH[/h1]

[h2]Valkyr Heirloom Collection[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/649245e9742d6ed5f8e7190ab12ba6d98c82677f.jpg[/img]
Create something spectacular as you transform a legacy of torment. The Valkyr Heirloom Collection will be available starting Monday, July 21!  

You'll have the choice to purchase the Valkyr Heirloom Collection either with Platinum or in your local currency (which will include bonus Platinum).

[url=https://www.warframe.com/news/valkyr-heirloom-collection]Learn more.[/url]

[h2]TennoCon Merch[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/9c77cb6ded942fc7f33f553137dc007ea28bfb6b.jpg[/img]
Honor the Origin System’s enduring legacy with loads of all-new Merch! Pick up absolutely scorching goodies like The Art of Warframe: Concept-Illustration-Design - Paperback Edition, Volante Stalker Jacket, Spirit Jersey, Aoi & Arthur Floofs and oh-so much more. It's all available now on the official Warframe Merch Store!

[url=https://store.warframe.com/collections/tennocon-merch-collections?utm_medium=display&utm_source=warframe.com&utm_campaign=2025-TennoConMerch]Shop now.[/url]

[h2]TennoCon Giveaways[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/8b620b733aed9d3cc7a02aa0cc24f4718ce5ba15.jpg[/img]
TennoCon may be over, but there's still plenty of time to win incredible prizes from our giveaway partners! From tech upgrades to clog customizations, we've got the rewards Tenno are looking for.

[url=https://www.warframe.com/news/tennocon-2025-giveaways-and-digital-extras]Learn more and enter our TennoCon giveaways today![/url]

[h1]THANKS TO OUR PARTNERS![/h1]

Your support for TennoCon means we can continue to uplift our charity recipients. This year we are proud to share that Digital Extremes has made a $100,000 donation to both Make-A-Wish Canada and the Canadian Mental Health Association. We encourage you to read more about their missions and how these donations will be used on their websites.

Thank you, Tenno. We all lift together. 

[h2]Make a Wish[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/4daa28c3be18c0625beb3c5a02721088596bd4e8.jpg[/img]
Make-A-Wish Canada works with communities across the country to provide children with critical illnesses the opportunity to realize their most heartfelt wish. These wishes are more than just moments of happiness; they are crucial in improving medical outcomes and enhancing the quality of life for both the children and their families.

[url=https://makeawishca.donordrive.com/events/1440]Donate now.[/url]

notes.title: Warframe's Isleweaver update is live right now, and we're headed back to Duviri
notes.content:
It's an open secret that I am deathly afraid of spiders. While smacking them around in games like Diablo and World of Warcraft has certainly helped, when one of those eight-legged demons appears in my flat, all hell breaks loose. So when I heard that the newest Warframe, the arachnid-inspired Oraxia, sports various insectoid legs and can effectively turn into a scrambling spider, I was pretty sure I'd be coming back for whatever update is after Isleweaver. Then, I heard we're returning to Duviri to chase after 1999's much-beloved Major Rosalka, and decided that it was time to put my fears aside and dive back into the weird, fantasy-inspired world that introduced me to Warframe in the first place.

Read the rest of the story...

We’re celebrating Warframe’s incredible LGBTQIA2S+ community! We are immensely proud to support and honor our wonderfully diverse players during Pride month and throughout the year.

This year, you can celebrate Pride by picking up in-game items, watching our fantastic LGBTQI2S+ Warframe Creators and plenty more!

We are deeply thrilled to once again support Rainbow Railroad, a global not-for-profit organization that helps at-risk LGBTQIA2S+ people get to safety worldwide. Operating in Canada and the United States, the organization helps LGBTQIA2S+ people facing persecution based on their sexual orientation, gender identity and sex characteristics. Learn more about this incredible organization by visiting their [url=https://www.rainbowrailroad.org/]website[/url].

To kick off the Pride festivities, Digital Extremes has donated $20,000 CAD to Rainbow Railroad! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/6241e423627b628e2a462cf60224cbea7c533132.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Yareli Prime - Coming May 21![/h2]
In a crashing of the waves comes Yareli Prime, [b]releasing May 21st with our Interim Cert Build![/b]

[previewyoutube=QYXfonwY6mM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Yareli Prime[/h3]
The Waverider arises, reborn from the ocean foam. In her original Orokin-era splendour she embodies the undying vigor of youth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/475d8bdc0066a659b95d3c3c94f4758b17a06abf.png[/img]
[b]Merulina Prime[/b]
Yareli Prime’s living board is the epitome of elegance and style

[b]Daikyu Prime[/b]
Long believed lost, the mighty Daikyu Prime was the pride of many a Tenno dojo. The strength demanded to draw it is repaid in added range and power.

[b]Kompressa Prime[/b]
Glinting like a golden dawn, Yareli Prime’s signature pistol engulfs foes in a cascade of virulent, explosive, water globules. None can escape the sea.

[h3]Yareli Prime Accessories[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/baa98f3f6b7981bfa1007046bd2182e8f78ba81d.png[/img]
[b]Merulina Prime Syandana[/b]
Yareli Prime’s faithful water-glider is happy to adorn her body as an additional ornament.

[b]Thalassa Prime Ephemera[/b]
Creatures of the deep circle and play in your wake. Yareli Prime’s signature ephemera.

[b]Merulina Prime Domestik Drone[/b]
Merulina’s tiny spawn are used to foraging on the sea bed, and adapt easily to nibbling up dirt from an Orbiter floor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/9c40c72f1973c9b2f90c9b821452deb26ab206cc.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Kullervo Apostate Deluxe Skin[/h2]
Joining Yareli Prime will be the Kullervo Apostate Deluxe skin, releasing in the Interim Cert Update on May 21st!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/0ed08bdf524ae91ceb6aa682509da5c4df7fa4b1.png[/img]
[b]Kullervo Apostate Skin[/b]
The eternal outcast has nothing left to fear.  Kullervo embodies rebellion and the will to endure whatever the oppressor can dish out.

[b]Kullervo Apostate Baneful Blades[/b]
Kullervo Apostate’s signature adornment. These blades can be equipped/unequipped via the Auxiliary option. They can also be equipped on other Kullervo skins. You can also use the default Baneful Blades on the Kullervo Apostate Skin.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Isleweaver - Coming June 2025[/h2]

[previewyoutube=TBsQROfuf0Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Let’s talk about our upcoming June update—[b]Isleweaver![/b]. To play Isleweaver, the player must have completed The Hex Quest. Isleweaver has the Tenno return to Duviri to tackle a new permanent node!

A certain “she-devil” has returned. Major Rusalka has turned up in Duviri alongside a Murmur armada, claiming a stake to the ethereal realm. The Drifter caused havoc in her world, now she’s looking to settle the score. 

Rusalka’s invasion into Duviri has left Dominus Thrax himself retreating into the Undercroft and our Dormizone, and revealed long-standing secrets lurking in this emotionally-torn dimension.

With Isleweaver, a new permanent node opens up in Duviri, where your Warframe will face off against the Murmur and engage in classic Duviri gameplay—that’s right, Drifter, time to take a backseat. Rebecca Ford gives us the rundown [url=https://www.twitch.tv/warframe/clip/KitschyClumsyChoughDoubleRainbow-RtSchygJWZS_G0ID]here![/url]

Our Principal Writer, Kat Kingsley, [url=https://www.twitch.tv/warframe/clip/GlutenFreeDifficultAmazonFunRun-NeyxvMnareSWxtDd]spoke more about Rusalka's return[/url] and what their presence means for the fate of Duviri and the Indifference.

[h3]Oraxia[/h3]
Our 61st Warframe—ORAXIA! Seek out weakened prey to siphon them for Health and Energy, ensnare your enemies in webs, summon spiderlings, and climb along walls only like a spider can, offering a fresh form of mobility in Warframe. Yes, Spiderframe is finally confirmed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/132b7b816805f6fe4402b295350e64e9c99101d2.png[/img]
Oraxia has been subjected to years of isolation, trapped within one of Duviri’s islands. This patient web-weaver was driven mad and now unable to tell friend from foe. Rusalka’s invasion reveals this new mini-boss to us, a Warframe we must take down.

As well, Oraxia will bring with her an Alternate Helmet, new Armor, a Melee Whip and a Secondary Throwing Weapon!

More details to come with Oraxia’s abilities!

[h3]Clan Event: Operation: Eight Claw[/h3]
Operation: Eight Claw expands on the previously-mentioned new permanent node to the Star Chart. Similar to Jade Shadows with Operation: Belly of the Beast, this Operation will launch alongside the release of Isleweaver.

Some of the rewards included with Operation: Eight Claw include a new evolving Signa and a new Incarnon Heavy Scythe!

[h3]Citrine Deluxe[/h3]
Additionally, we showed off [url=https://www.twitch.tv/warframe/clip/FaintRespectfulPterodactylCoolCat-dE2NpQEorHjENoAY] Citrine’s Deluxe skin in-game[/url], which will be coming with Isleweaver!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Heirloom Skins[/h2]
We also revealed our incoming Heirloom skins: Valkyr and Vauban Heirlooms! 

[h3]Valkyr Heirloom[/h3]
First on the docket is our Valkyr Heirloom, [b]releasing on July 21st![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/d308dece807815adea9a4156de06cc61c6375202.png[/img]
Designed by community artist [url=https://x.com/perttibahaan?lang=en]Pertti Bahaa[/url], we’ve worked together to bring this goddess of war to the next level. [url=https://www.twitch.tv/warframe/clip/AwkwardBoldPandaKappaWealth-lCxWPvANW-E8xyBv]Here’s a quick look at her in-game![/url]

[h3]Vauban Heirloom[/h3]
While not arriving alongside Valkyr Heirloom, we wanted to reveal our next male Heirloom skin with Vauban Heirloom! Thank you to community artist [url=https://x.com/lua_luminary?lang=en]Lua_Luminary[/url] for crafting the original concept that we’re excited to work on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/e5c62742b48e89be03a39dc7adffb0c17d0161c4.jpg[/img]
Vauban Heirloom will enter the Market in the early months of 2026, not unlike how Rhino Heirloom launched early this year!

Thanks for reading, Tenno!

notes.title: Warframe's next major update gives the monster sickos what they've been begging for: a Spider warframe at long last
notes.content:
The next big Warframe update has been revealed at Pax East, and is bringing the playerbase a long-speculated warframe concept. Oraxia, a spider-themed warframe, will be a major part of the Isleweaver update set to go live in June. A specific date has yet to be announced.

Read more

notes.title: Isleweaver Coming in June
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=TBsQROfuf0Y;full][/previewyoutube]
No need to adjust your television sets, Tenno. You're not in a Spiral yet, but you'll see the floating islands of Duviri in a whole new way when Isleweaver launches this June!

That's right, announced live in the Main Theatre at PAX East, Isleweaver will be turning Duviri on its head very soon.

Along with the return of Major Neci Rusalka, Isleweaver brings the 61st Warframe: Oraxia, and the opportunity to unleash your Warframes in Duviri with a unique twist on Duviri gameplay.

Join together with your Clan to take on Operation: Eight Claw and earn Arcanes, Customizations, and more!

[h2]Isleweaver[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/c0b91fd0d0a8672ccee8893d8ac6935e7f085cd7.png[/img]
Dominus Thrax is outwardly repulsed but inwardly terrified of the Major's and the Murmur’s recent incursion into his territory.

To expedite her swift removal from the Kingdom of Duviri, Thrax is allowing the Tenno to use their Warframes in Duviri for the first time outside of the Circuit!

Embark on a new journey across Duviri to put a stop to the Murmur invasion before the Indifference can claim the mind-bending floating islands for itself.

[h2]Oraxia: Ensnaring Hunter[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/132b7b816805f6fe4402b295350e64e9c99101d2.png[/img]
The patient hunter Oraxia has made the Scholar's Landing her lair. There she lurks, driven too mad to tell friend from foe, awaiting those foolish enough to wander into her trap.

Slip the spider's snare and defeat Oraxia to earn Scuttler's Husks, which you can trade for Oraxia Warframe Component Blueprints as well as Blueprints for her signature Weapons.

Oraxia's Abilities center around isolating and executing weakened enemies, using her wall-crawling mobility to outmaneuver the enemy, and encasing her prey in immobilizing webs.

Seek out weakened prey to siphon them for health and energy!

[h2] Valkyr Rework [/h2]

In Isleweaver, the ferocious and furious Warframe Valkyr will be receiving some changes to dial in her wild berserker playstyle.

Channel her Rage in an all-new way as you rip and tear your way through enemies!

Learn more about the changes in our full Dev Workshop.

Are you ready to return to Duviri next month, Tenno? Stay tuned for more details on when you can play Isleweaver very soon!

notes.content:

notes.content:
Nightwave is transmitting a new signal that’s calling you to uncover rare and ever-so-mysterious goods! Nora’s Mix Vol. 9 launches on May 21 at 2 p.m. ET with fresh and returning Rewards that will leave you utterly starstruck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/ca7ddaeb58e0c7fe3f5ee27ac67d7a766c3fb17b.png[/img]
Earn a heavenly new Xaku Skin, a radiant Syandana, an otherworldly Ephemera, and more by completing challenges during Missions. Gather Cred and exchange it for cosmic treasures directly from Nora, including rare resources and exclusive Rewards. No Platinum is necessary — just your dedication to the stars.

[h3]Nora’s Mix Vol. 9 Rewards:[/h3]
[list][*]Xaku Raya Skin

[url=https://www.warframe.com/news/nightwave-guide]Nightwave[/url] is a pirate radio broadcast hosted by Nora Night, focused on the latest stories in the Origin System. Nightwave is available via the Orbiter’s Navigation console or through the Orbiter’s radio scanner (located on the left side of your Orbiter’s bridge). In the Nightwave menu, you’ll see your progress through the current season, your current Reward Tiers, as well as a rotating set of Daily, Weekly, Elite Weekly and Permanent Weekly Acts. Stick with Nightwave each day and get some fantastic Customizations!

notes.title: Protoframe Fashion Frame Contest
notes.content:
In Techrot Encore, we met a few more Protoframes that make up the fabric of Warframe: 1999. Kaya, Velimir, Minerva, and Flare have joined the roster alongside Arthur, Amir, Aoi, Eleanor, Lettie, and Quincy.

Customize a Protoframe with your best fashion for a chance to win Lavos Prime Access and more! To help you with your glam, the Caliber Chicks Killian Shoulder Pad will be on sale for [b]50% off[/b] in the in-game market for the duration of this contest.

Share a Captura of your best Protoframe Fashion Frame in [url=https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1450240-protoframe-fashion-frame-contest/]this forum thread.[/url]

[i]Can you edit your screenshot? Yes, if you want! Just let us know in your forum post if your Captura is edited.[/i]

[list][*]1st place – Lavos Prime Access + Gemini Skin of your choice
[*]2nd place – 1000 Platinum + Gemini Skin of your choice
[*]3rd place – 750 Platinum + Gemini Skin of your choice
[*]4th place – 600 Platinum + Gemini Skin of your choice
[*]5th place – 500 Platinum + Gemini Skin of your choice[/list]

notes.title: Warframe's Spring Celebration 2025

notes.title: Techrot Encore Coming March 19
notes.content:
The signal is stronger than ever, Tenno — [b]Techrot Encore arrives on March 19 at 11 a.m. ET[/b] for all platforms! 

Bear witness to the infectious Technocyte Coda’s on-stage debut, take on an all-new challenges in Temporal Archimedea, bring down the house with Temple’s ruinous riffs, and plenty more in what might be our biggest Echoes Update yet, you will! Let’s go into a bit more detail in the sections below. 

[hr][/hr]
[h3]New Warframe: Temple[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/dec9c9a4c387dec9045d92cda8df6a8c17ce1ef4.png[/img]

Taking cues from glam rock legends of decades past, Temple is all about wielding the awesome power of guitar licks to shred through opponents. Each of their harmonious abilities result in a pyrotechnics show with deadly results!

[b]Passive - Backbeat:[/b] Play abilities in sync with the Backbeat metronome to invigorate ability effects while increasing Ability Efficiency by 50%.

[b]Ability 1 - Pyrotechnics:[/b] Blast targeted enemies with pillars of fire. 

[b]Ability 2 - Overdrive:[/b] Drive loudspeakers into epic distortion to create a damaging wave of Heat while also increasing vulnerability to Critical Chance. 

[b]Ability 3 - Ripper’s Wail:[/b] Rip on the guitar to make Temple briefly invulnerable while healing them. Ally’s weapons are lit-up with extra Heat Damage.

[b]Ability 4 - Exalted Solo:[/b] Set Lizzie aflame and torch enemies with Heat. While aimed, Lizzie blasts enemies with thunderous elemental sound waves, use ability controls to change the Elemental Damage type.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]New Protoframes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/0eb30d0d4812df73cebc29eaca40a1422acbd678.png[/img]

It would seem Albrecht Entrati's shadow over Höllvania extends further than previously thought, as Techrot Encore is adding four brand-new Protoframes, including new Gemini Skins and Gemini Emotes for Saryn, Frost, Nova, and Temple.

[h4]Minerva[/h4]

A former Libertatian military agent, Minerva is used to her orders being followed… immediately. Cunning and beauty in equal measure, the Protoframe of Saryn has arrived in Höllvania.

[h4]Velimir[/h4]

A resolute veteran of many conflicts, Velimir's frigid exterior quickly melts for those he is close to. The Protoframe of Frost brings a human face to an icy Warframe. 

[h4]Kaya[/h4]

Capable and cocky, Kaya is an engineering genius, despite being the youngest of the group. The Protoframe of Nova is eager to put her newfound powers of matter manipulation into practice. 

[h4]Flare[/h4]

Flare has transcended merely creating art, and thanks to Albrecht Entrati and the Technocyte Virus, they have become the art. The Protoframe of Temple is a spectacle that has to be seen to be believed.  

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Technocyte Coda[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/2a3a1be90424751ed9f4090e03cb0f45b0f3d0ff.png[/img]

At long last, the boys are in sync and there’s no turning back — the Technocyte Coda make their on-stage debut to shatter your resolve with lethal, ear-piercing beats. Take on this show-stopping challenge to earn new Coda Weapons and Customizations! For a more in-depth look, check out our [url="https://www.warframe.com/news/technocyte-coda-deep-dive"]Technocyte Coda deep dive[/url] article! 

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Temporal Archimedea[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/cc3950d8bddb007761ea815eaa6e879f0606895c.jpg[/img]

For those looking for a steep challenge, this twist on Deep Archimedia should do the trick! You will be able to spice up Missions with "Peely Pix" stickers that apply unique modifiers. Keep in mind that these outings will undoubtedly require powerful loadouts and a healthy degree of coordination with your squadmates to clear. 

[hr][/hr]
[h3]New KIM Conversations[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/99b6b8782c5984c1fba24c4e57b9b99dd7ad91af.png[/img]

What better way to get to know the new Protoframes than with a little back-and-fourth chat? While Minerva, Velimir, Kaya, and Flare are not romanceable, you can still deepen your bonds as well as strengthen their ties to The Hex and each other. Who knows? Maybe they’ll even give you some hints about the past and future of other characters in the world of Warframe...

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Welcome to The Round Table![/h3]

Pull up a stool and introduce yourself to new faces in the Höllvania Central Mall! Visit this once-bustling pub and browse their wares to add stylish furniture Decorations to your Inventory.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Ollie's Crash Course[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/ed6f7c276d864f95c349981fea2d7053580518e6.png[/img]

Kick the tires and light the fires with your Atomicycle through an out-of-this-world obstacle course, inspired by retro arcade racing games. Outsmart and outrace Ollie, with voice acting by James Conlin! Try out Ollie's Crash Course by interacting with the arcade bikes in the Höllvania Central Mall.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]General QOL[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/c071ea632c9b67447b2df0309a383dcdfb5f3593.png[/img]

Plenty of Quality-of-Life improvements and other adjustments arrive with Techrot Encore, including an Ash Ability retouch and redesigned Omni Forma (previously Aura Forma) that lets you apply a Universal Polarity to any Mod Slot. Stay tuned for more information soon!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Collaboration with Mark and Jake[/h3]

Mark Holcomb and Jake Bowen, members of the prog metal band Periphery, along with Good Tiger vocalist Elliot Coleman, are collaborating with us on a new song you’ll hear in Techrot Encore on March 19! In the meantime, prepare to play your own tunes with our [url="https://gleam.io/jC4tj/warframe-guitar-giveaway"]Guitar Giveaway[/url] courtesy of Mark and Jake!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]New TennoGen Bundles[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/b1beb1c74a1b677d42eb733860bc09091c66bfc9.png[/img]

Several new TennoGen Customizations will release alongside Techrot Encore, including a brand new Styanax Skin, two Syandanas, new Shoulder Armor, and Voruna's first Tennogen Skin! More information will arrive in the weeks to come.

notes.title: Warframe 1999's colossal new update adds Temple, two new modes, boyband bosses
notes.content:
Warframe 1999 is, for me, the coolest thing to come out of the game in years. Set in the Germanic-style world of Höllvania, the update added everything from a dating simulator to an infested boy band, and is the sole reason I chose to pick up my katana and dive on into the Origin System. But Arthur and the Hex's story isn't over yet, as Techrot Encore is bringing a lot of new 1999-themed content, continuing the saga and expanding out the game's already impressive roster. With the release date finally set in stone, we caught up with design director Pablo Alonso to talk all things Techrot and Temple.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Operation: Belly of the Beast Returns
notes.content:
It’s time to bring your Clan’s full strength to bear, Tenno — [b]Operation: Belly of the Beast is live until March 3 at 2 p.m. ET.[/b] This is your chance to claim potent rewards like Arcane Energize, Arcane Grace, and Arcane Barrier.

[h3]What You Need To Know[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/5ca6ca54a480c67f9ec892f57bb9d67d410e2ef1.png[/img]

Operation: Belly of the Beast requires you to step into Stalker’s Lair — only those who have completed the [b]Jade Shadows Quest[/b] are permitted to do so.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]What You Need To Do[/h3]

While Operation: Belly of the Beast is live, players will have access to special nodes that allow them to take on Parvos' forces. During these Missions, all Eximus units that spawn will be Jade Light Eximus units. You can help Ordis in his mission to stop Parvos in one of three ways:

1. Operation Variant of Brutus (Uranus)
2. Operation Alerts
3. Stalker Joins the Fray

[h4]Operation Variant of Brutus (Uranus)[/h4]

In traditional Operation style, the new Brutus node on Uranus has its own Operation variant. Play Ascension as you know it, but with all Eximus units spawning in as Jade Light Eximus.

Summoning a Sister of Parvos will also reward players with additional Volatile Motes.

[h4]Operation Alerts[/h4]

In addition to the Brutus node on Uranus, timed Operation Alerts will appear across the Origin System that also award players with Volatile Motes. These non-Ascension Missions will have their normal Mission gameplay, but will also spawn Jade Light Eximus in place of regular Eximus units. Look for these time-limited Alerts to appear every hour or so as an alternative method to earn Volatile Motes.

[h4]Stalker Joins the Fray[/h4]

Visiting Ordis in the Larunda Relay not only allows you to earn Operation Rewards, but also lets you call on an old foe to assist in your efforts. In speaking to Ordis, selecting the [i]“A Shared Purpose?”[/i] option will allow you to join another Squad’s mission as the Stalker! Doing so will reward you with the usual Mission Rewards — at the risk of losing them all should you be downed during combat.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Rewards[/h3]

notes.title: Devstream 184 Overview
notes.content:
Thanks for joining us for the[url=https://www.warframe.com/news/devstream-184-overview] first Devstream of 2025[/url]! The team is excited to be back and show you what we've been cooking for you to play this year.

If you want to watch the full stream, you can check it out on YouTube now. We'll also be recapping some of the biggest news we shared, so keep reading!

[h3]TECHROT ENCORE COMING MARCH[/h3]
The fun in Warframe: 1999 continues with Techrot Encore, launching this March! This huge follow-up update to 1999 will bring the long-awaited Technocyte Coda to the Origin System for you to track down, as well as four new Protoframes and a brand-new Warframe: Temple.

Tune in to our February Devstream to learn more about what you can expect from Techrot Encore this March!

[h3]TENNOCON 2025 TICKET SALES BEGIN ON FEB 7[/h3]
Set your navigation for London, Ontario, Canada! TennoCon 2025 tickets will go on sale on Friday, February 7 through Eventbrite.

Join us for a day full of panels, reveals, and celebrating the incredible Warframe community.

No matter what physical ticket you buy, all Tenno will be welcome to attend a special new night of live Warframe music called TennoConcert at the Canada Life Place arena on the first day of TennoCon on Friday, July 18, 2025.

[h3]LAVOS PRIME ACCESS BEGINS FEB 12 [/h3]
Become the master of Transmutation as Lavos Prime enters Prime Access in February! Wielding his signature Prime Weapons and exclusive Prime Accessories, the elemental alchemist is ready to walk the path of glory in the Origin System once again.

Get Lavos Prime, Cedo Prime, and Dual Zoren Prime, along with exclusive Prime Accessories and more when Lavos Prime Access begins on February 12.

[h3]GYRE DELUXE [/h3]
Empower the elegant conduit with an electrifying new look! Enjoy a sneak peek at Gyre’s Deluxe Skin, slated for release later this year!

[h3]NIGHTWAVE AND BELLY OF THE BEAST RETURN IN FEBRUARY[/h3]
Not sure what to play this month? We've got you covered, as February kicks off with the return of Nightwave in Nora's Mix Vol.8 [i]and[/i] the fan-favorite Belly of the Beast event from Jade Shadows!

In Nightwave, complete Nora Night's Acts to Rank Up and earn 1999-themed Customizations.

Belly of the Beast will see you working alongside your clanmates and the Warframe Community to earn fantastic rewards. But act fast, Tenno. You only have until March 3 before the event ends!

[hr][/hr]
For more information on everything we showed at Devstream 184, we encourage you to read our [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/devstream-184-overview]full Devstream Overview[/url].

See you in the Origin System, Tenno!

notes.title: Warframe: 1999 Coming In December
notes.content:
Our biggest update of the 20th century arrives this December when Warframe: 1999 launches on all platforms! Make sure you're up-to-date on everything we've revealed so far by visiting the official [url=https://www.warframe.com/1999]Warframe: 1999 website[/url]. [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/how-to-get-ready-for-the-new-warframe-update]Get your account ready[/url] and check out our [url=https://www.warframe.com/guides/quests]official Quest Guide[/url] to ensure that you'll be able to jump straight into the action on launch day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/c70a7aac5b34b8372308c1f9e0686a26bc91d425.png[/img]
If you can't wait until then and need a taste of 1999 to hold you over, [url=https://www.warframe.com/get-ready]you can log in right now and try your hand at our playable demo[/url]. Get a feel for Arthur's Weaponry and turbo-charged Atomicycle as you battle Scaldra through the streets of Hӧllvania.

December just can't come soon enough…

[h1]Calendar Seasons System[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/949bf381144fb637b827ccc209788ad37993a187.png[/img]
1999 will utilize a new playable Calendar system similar to The Circuit in Duviri, but themed according to 4 changing Seasons: Winter, Spring, Summer, and Fall. Each week in 1999 will represent a new "Season," and gameplay will vary.

Stay tuned for more details on what we have in store!

[h1]Technocyte Coda Deep Dive[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/604660fb229465f0eef6ad4941e22dd9c703baa0.png[/img]
As with the Grineer and Corpus before them, the Infestation will enjoy its own Adversary system when 1999 launches, called the "Technocyte Coda." Noticeably different from Kuva Liches and Sisters of Parvos, the Technocyte Coda system will nonetheless enable Tenno to earn a new suite of ultra-powerful Infested Weaponry.

Check out our [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/technocyte-coda-deep-dive]Technocyte Coda Deep Dive[/url] for more details!

[h1]Gemini Series Skins: Amir, Lettie[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/ff79a0938fd392d41137c0aac6d5c5c3ebead548.png[/img]
During TennoCon 2024, we revealed Arthur's transforming Gemini Series Skin and watched him morph in real-time from Protoframe to Warframe. Now we have two more transforming Skins to tempt you with: those of [b]Lettie (Trinity)[/b] and [b]Amir (Volt)[/b]!

See them for yourself [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/gemini-series-skins]right here[/url].

[h1]New Atomicycle, Drifter Customizations[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/6b6fc11083ee6e439dcb37b2d691cace61e30d27.png[/img]

Your Atomicycle will be more than just a means of traversing Hӧllvania — it also marks a whole new platform for Fashion Frame! Customize your ride with 11 different Skins and embrace the need for speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/6f96b285c546d13192b4eba7f80421c3016e60a3.jpg[/img]

You'll be able to personalize your Drifter, as well! Give them an [b]athletic[/b], [b]military[/b], [b]Y2K[/b], or [b]goth[/b] aesthetic thanks to a broad new suite of Customization options.

[h1]Comic Book Cover Revealed[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/a96fc6b2170676fe93d652cc4752260f8b3548e7.png[/img]
Created in partnership with community artist [url=https://x.com/tbgkaru]Karu[/url], our long-awaited Protoframe webcomic will be available in mid-November!

Find it on Warframe's very own [url=https://www.warframe.com/media]Media Page[/url], or via additional outlets such as Tapas Canvas, Webtoon, Reddit and Imgur. Click [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/warframe-1999-webcomic-coming-soon]here[/url] for more details.

A Comic Poster Orbiter Decoration will also be released today at 3 p.m. ET.

[h1]The Line Animation Studios Teaser[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/15bfb5db68fe07bb531317e70b66f83449f038c4.png[/img]
The Line Animation Studios has entered the final week of production on our upcoming 1999-inspired anime short! The promotional still below gives an idea of the final, grim look that the studio is aiming for once the completed animation is released later this year.

Click [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/the-line-to-produce-warframe-animated-short]here[/url] for more details.

[h1]Trinity Light Rework[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/c2a070c80de6ae84c2cb6a9281631815974401dc.png[/img]
A light touch-up to Trinity's Abilities bolsters her power in advance of Warframe: 1999! We focused especially on Ability durations and her Well of Life, while also replacing her Passive entirely. Watch for further changes to Nyx, which we'll announce as part of our November Devstream.

notes.title: TGS 2024 Recap
notes.content:
Bringing Warframe to this year's Tokyo Game Show was an unforgettable experience, and we were thrilled to showcase the Origin System from our booth at Hall 07-C01! We're grateful to everyone who joined us in person, as well as those who kept the hype train rolling from home. If you missed out on the excitement as it happened in Japan, we've compiled a brief recap for you below — including some stellar shots taken directly from the show floor.

[h2]Devstream 181[/h2]

Just a few days before the update launched, [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/Br7Svsdpacc]Devstream 181[/url] unveiled Koumei & the Five Fates. Watch the Japanese version of the official gameplay trailer below, featuring the voice talent of Kenjiro Tsuda:

[previewyoutube=D6iblGunMnQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Creative Director Rebecca Ford and Community Director Megan Everett took us deeper than ever into the recent update, which includes several new Deluxe Skins, Reworks, QoL enhancements, and so much more. They even returned the following day with a [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/live/9qhwoFXqYMs]Bonus Recap stream[/url][/b], ensuring that everyone got an up-close look at the content-to-come.

In addition to Koumei, the team announced an [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/warframe-1999-demo-coming-october-16]upcoming playable demo for Warframe: 1999[/url], and a [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/calibans-new-adaptations]free Caliban giveaway[/url] running until October 16!

[b]Want to learn more?[/b]

Our [url=https://www.warframe.com/koumei-and-the-five-fates]official Koumei & the Five Fates webpage[/url] has all the links and details you'll need.

For a recap of Devstream 181, check out our official [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/devstream-181-highlights]Highlights[/url], or get the full nitty-gritty from our complete [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/devstream-181-overview]Devstream Overview[/url].

[h2]Mobile Showcase[/h2]

Attendees were treated to a new iOS trailer during the Mobile Gaming Show, presented by Future Games Show and hosted by Warframe: 1999 voice actor Ben Starr:

[previewyoutube=OYv8dujbxuE;full][/previewyoutube]
Released as part of a wider push into the Japanese market, the latest trailer highlights Warframe's deep customization, mobile-optimized graphics and epic narrative. Android users who are hoping to join Warframe on Mobile can watch out for a launch date signup list before the end of the year.

[h2]At The Event[/h2]

Our booth offered a broad look at all things Warframe, designed to entice fans but also introduce the Origin System to new Tenno for the first time. Those in attendance may have noticed some of the same eye-catching designs we recently featured at TennoCon 2024!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/4fa67f90d9dee68f7d7f48b9e759d703f4701f90.jpg[/img]
A variety of activities and demonstrations helped bring Warframe to life:

[h2]Parkour Display[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/85c9f08b169247bd1d83b8f180b91e063438cfdf.jpg[/img]
What better way to help prospective Tenno get a feel for Warframe's unique style of movement than by watching a live parkour show? The gravity-defying traversal of a Warframe is one thing in-game, but seeing it live in front of you is something else entirely. Thank you to our talented (and athletic) performers!

[h2]Appearance by Alpha Takahashi[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/479ee7b2289ff140b0281775d879d56cf35caa55.jpg[/img]
In addition to appearing live on stage with Rebecca and Megan during Devstream 181, actor Alpha Takahashi also appeared at the Warframe booth to mingle with fans and build excitement for her upcoming role as Aoi in Warframe: 1999.

[h2]Live Demonstration[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/98729f6479f5807b2c2f187d091accea90a9fb42.jpg[/img]
Warframe is a vast and deep experience. As such, we understand how overwhelming it can sometimes be — especially for new Tenno. Fortunately, our booth featured an enrapturing live demonstration of the game's various systems and features, and served as a helpful (and entertaining) introduction to the journey awaiting them.

[h2]Demo Stations[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/d2f208910d41e7ad3f0bbe0bda73da4ec1c39453.jpg[/img]
Of course, there's no better way to understand the feel of a Warframe than by jumping right in and trying one out for yourself! Our booth included several PC and console setups so that attendees could experience our frenetic, fast-paced combat in real-time.

[h2]Merch and Giveaways[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/5c89e1f29a690a56a2661ad1b24b84845ceb6330.jpg[/img]
Official Warframe Merchandise on hand included a Warframe logo'd T-shirt (available in either white or black), along with a Warframe: 1999-themed towel.

A special gacha machine was set up to dispense Void Relics to eager fans containing various Warframe-themed pins, keychains and personal Platinum codes.

notes.title: 10 Quick Tips For Jumping into Warframe
notes.content:
Welcome to Warframe! There’s a wide world of intense action in front of you and we’re glad that you’re joining us in the Origin System. As you awake from cryosleep and take control of your chosen Warframe, there are some things you might not know about the game. To help familiarize you with Warframe, we’re offering this handy list of tips. These should have you bullet jumping into the action in no time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/c95f3de706574ac943720a79c77e7b6f8d0dc7dd.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Complete The Star Chart First[/h3]
The [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/star-chart]Star Chart[/url] is your map of the entire Origin System. Progressing through each Junction and following the main [url=https://www.warframe.com/guides/quests]Quests[/url] should be your primary focus. As you progress through Junctions, you’ll find yourself unlocking new planets and Mission locations, which will reward you with new Warframes and resources. Without a completed Star Chart, you won’t have access to certain resources needed to craft future Warframes, equipment, and other upgrades. 

[h3]Come Back to the Open Landscapes Later[/h3]
While [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/open-worlds-guide]Open Landscapes[/url] like the Plains of Eidolon and the Orb Vallis will appear early in your journey, it’s best to move beyond them and return later. The highest-level Bounties and opportunities to rank up with Syndicates found in these locations will require some foundational Warframe knowledge and upgraded loadouts that you’ll gain as you fill out your Star Chart. They’ll still be there when you come back!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/4714140dc716372ca58de77a0e8eed04fa9b36b3.png[/img]

[h3]Stick To Squads Early On[/h3]
You can queue up for missions as a solo player, but Warframe is generally meant to be enjoyed in [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/multiplayer-guide]multiplayer[/url] squads. A squad of Tenno is much faster when it comes to completing objectives and finishing off foes. If you’re brand-new and you find that veteran players zoom ahead without you, don’t get discouraged; with time, you’ll settle into the same pace. It might also help you to queue up for missions with a friend who can walk you through some aspects of missions you might not understand. 

[h3]Pursue Mastery Ranks[/h3]
Your Mastery Rank is the level of your Warframe account, a tangible marker of your overall progress. In fact, certain events and equipment are locked behind higher Mastery Ranks! You can check your current Mastery Rank in the top-left corner of the Main Menu, or by selecting “Profile” and then “My Profile” on the same menu screen.

You gain Mastery Ranks by using Warframes and Weapons in missions, which levels them up. Raising your Mastery Rank quickly requires fully Mastering all the Warframes and Weapons available to you, which tends to happen at Rank 30. Even if you find a particular Warframe or Weapon isn’t your favorite, Master it before you move on! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/dcb436a71cff72f4a53eed959467ac8b3f2c3ace.png[/img]

[h3]The Codex Is Your Friend[/h3]
If you have a question about a specific Warframe, Mod, or the vast array of enemies coming after you, look into your Codex! The Codex is an in-game database of information on Warframe. You can find the Codex console in your Orbiter on the left side, or access it through the Main Menu under the “Profile” section. The Codex is also where you can keep track of all of the main and side quests available to you; if you want to dive deep into the story of Warframe, the Codex is where you start. 

[h3]Equip Your Mods[/h3]
Mods are a key aspect of enhancing your Warframes and Weapons. Without any Mods equipped, you only reach a fraction of your potential strength. A good practice in Missions is to explore and loot everything. In time, and with enough Missions, you should be collecting Mods at a steady pace. While the system looks complex, we have [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/mods-guide]a handy guide[/url] that should help you get your Warframes fit for the fight. Make sure to always equip Mods to reach your Warframe or Weapon’s maximum capacity. Pro tip: Early on, you only need one copy of most Mods, so dissolve the duplicates into Endo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/572ac1163dae4d25e42fbcde6e75fee12a1fdc25.png[/img]

[h3]Master The Bullet Jump[/h3]
Early in the game, you’ll be taught one of the primary movements mechanics in Warframe: the Bullet Jump. This move is done by crouching and then jumping, which shoots your Warframe forward a good distance. Combined with other moves like the Double Jump, or aiming your Weapon while jumping to slow your fall with the Aim Glide, the Bullet Jump is how most players get around in Warframe. Learn to chain bullet jumps together by Bullet Jumping into a slide by crouching again, putting you into the right position to Bullet Jump once again.

As an additional tip, if you aim your camera upwards prior to your Bullet Jump, the jump will be aimed upwards, shooting you high into the air. This additional movement technique can make a substantial difference when traversing the environment in your earliest missions. 

[h3]Use The Market and The Foundry[/h3]
Part of gaining power in Warframe is through [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/collect-and-customize-guide]new equipment[/url]. While you’ll be given some Weapons and Warframes just by progressing through the game, most will need to be crafted in the Foundry. Before you craft a Weapon however, you need to pick up the Blueprint for that weapon. 

Some Blueprints can be found on the Market, which is accessible through the Market console in your Orbiter or the “Market” section of the Main Menu. In the Weapons section of the Market, you’ll find available Weapons. Click through and you’ll find the option to buy the Blueprint for a Weapon, usually with Credits. With that Blueprint, you can return to the Foundry and assuming you have the right resources, start building a new Weapon. You'll also have the option to instantly add that Weapon or Warframe to your Arsenal with Platinum, the premium currency in Warframe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/53a576f9e0a0312f4388a42f1f86f3847ebe9f33.png[/img]

[h3]Join a Clan[/h3]
Clans in Warframe are persistent groups of like-minded players. While you might be tempted to go solo, joining a Clan gives you access to the Clan Dojo. Not only is a Dojo a great place to congregate with other players, it also gives you access to the labs, which offer Clan-exclusive Blueprints for Weapons, Warframes, and Resources. We’re all working together in Warframe, so it’s good to make friends!

[h3]Take Your Time[/h3]
There’s a lot of fun within Warframe, but as a new player you can’t do everything. If you try to complete everything shown in your Star Chart and Navigation console, you’ll be pulled in a hundred different directions trying to complete Alerts, Nightwave missions, Events, and more. Once you’ve completed the Star Chart and finished the main quests, find the aspect of Warframe that speaks to you, whether that’s Open Landscapes, Alerts, or even just fishing! Take your time and find out what’s fun for you.

To celebrate both Caliban's highly-anticipated Rework and his new Orfeo Collection, we're also offering every Tenno a FREE Caliban Warframe (including an accompanying Warframe Slot and pre-installed Orokin Reactor).[b] To earn yours, simply log into Warframe between October 2 and October 16 at 11:59 p.m. ET and claim him from your Inbox![/b]

[h3]Caliban's New Adaptations[/h3]
Heir to the twin kingdoms of Tau and Sol, Caliban debuted during The New War as the very first Sentient-Warframe hybrid. True to his origins, he's recently undergone a number of dramatic adaptations for improved playability that every Tenno should know about:

[h3]Caliban Rework[/h3]
Sweeping changes have been made to Caliban's Abilities — not only to increase his overall strength but also to enhance the fantasy of wielding Sentient powers. To that end, this Rework officially formalizes Tau Damage, which Caliban now deals out extensively.

Razor Gyre has become a Status-inflicting "traversal tool," while Sentient Wrath is now more in line with the Crowd Control Abilities found among other Warframes. Casting Lethal Progeny will summon new types of Sentient allies, and Fusion Strike has seen a variety of Quality of Life improvements for a more satisfying experience.

For full details, visit the [url=https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1414150-dev-workshop-koumei-the-five-fates-caliban-nova-rework]Official Warframe Forums[/url]!

[h3]Caliban Orfeo[/h3]
Inspired by the fierce devotion of his mythological namesake, Caliban Orfeo channels both the Old War and the Otherworld with an impressive (but ghastly) new Deluxe Skin. Venture forth boldly in the face of death with Caliban Orfeo, or get the complete Caliban Orfeo Collection to instantly add the Seighe Venato Skin, Heurodis Ephemera and Heurodis Decoration to your Arsenal, as well. notes.title: Steam Account Binding & Auto Login
notes.content:
As announced on Devstream 181, we’re improving the login experience for users that launch Warframe from Steam with the introduction of Account Binding and Auto-Login in the Koumei & The Five Fates update! 

[i]This is accurate at the time of writing, if there are any changes they will be reflected in the Koumei & The Five Fates update patch notes. [/i]

[h2]Account Binding [/h2]
Account Binding allows a Warframe account to bind to a Steam account, so that upon launching Warframe from Steam you do not need to input your credentials to log in. Instead, clicking the “Login With Steam” button will log you right into the game and bypass this step!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/fd7d4f6d3f1b1af285fce8b2a3d66eb1be9d02a5.jpg[/img]
[h3]What to Expect: [/h3]
After Koumei & The Five Fates goes live, when you launch Warframe from Steam and click the “Login With Steam” button you will be prompted to bind your Steam account to either:
[olist]
[*] An existing Warframe account OR
[*] A new Warframe Account that’ll be automatically bound to the Steam account you are signed into
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/034f4e8a49a2667b670dc50a2655ab0e0de71589.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Binding Existing Warframe Account:[/b]

1. Select the [b]“Bind Existing”[/b] option to bind an existing Warframe account to the Steam account you are currently logged into. 

2. Fill the email and password fields with the credentials associated with the Warframe account you want to bind to the Steam account you are currently logged into and hit “Confirm”. 
[list]
[*] [u][b]NOTE: Please check to make sure that you are linking the correct accounts (both your Warframe AND Steam account), as the link cannot be undone. [/b][/u]
[*] [url=https://www.warframe.com/2fa-faq]TennoGuard Two-Factor Authentication[/url] is required to bind a Warframe account to protect against fraud and prevent someone from binding your Warframe account to the wrong Steam account. 
[*] If you have TennoGuard enabled on the Warframe account you are attempting to bind, upon hitting “Confirm” you will be prompted to enter a code that was sent to your email. Once entered, you have completed the account binding process! 
[*] If you have not enabled TennoGuard on the Warframe account you are attempting to bind, learn how to in our [url=https://www.warframe.com/2fa-faq]TennoGuard Two-Factor Authentication FAQ[/url]. 
[/list]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/920938516f67ad3759db6d9a09f28b03ede87ff1.jpg[/img]

Warframe accounts bound to Steam still adhere to the Cross Platform Save restrictions (more details in our [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/cross-platform-save#FAQheader]FAQ[/url]). 

This new Account Binding system replaces the Steam Economy binding and operates the same way –  meaning, in order to purchase TennoGen from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/230410/]Steam Store[/url] (specifically from the website, in-game Market not impacted), you must bind a Warframe account to a Steam account. 
[list]
[*]If you have bound a Warframe account to Steam Economy before Koumei & The Five Fates launches, you may encounter the following scenarios depending on the Warframe and Steam accounts you attempt to bind through the new Account Binding system launching the the update (expand spoilers): 
[/list]
[b]Scenario A:[/b]  If I have Steam account A already bound to Warframe account A with Steam Economy, but I go to bind Steam account A to Warframe account B, C, D. etc. after Koumei & The Five Fates launches, I will not be able to, and will receive an error and have to submit a ticket to support. This is because that Steam account is already bound to a Warframe account, and cannot be bound twice. 

[b]Scenario B:[/b] If I have Steam account A already bound to Warframe account A with Steam Economy, but then I go to bind Steam Account B, C, D etc... to Warframe account A after Koumei & The Five Fates launches, I will not be able to, and will receive an error and have to submit a ticket to support. This is because that Warframe account is already bound to a Steam account, and cannot be bound twice. 

[b]Scenario C:[/b] If I have Steam account A already bound to Warframe account A through Steam Economy before the update next week, I will [b]NOT[/b] have issues with the new account binding system after Koumei & The Five Fates launches as long as I am binding Steam Account A to Warframe account A

[b]Note:[/b] Other purchases made from the Steam Store do not require you to bind to Steam Economy, only if you had specifically purchased TennoGen. 

[hr][/hr]
[b]Creating and Binding New Warframe Account:[/b]

Select the [b]“Create New”[/b] option to create a new Warframe account that will be bound to the Steam account you are currently logged into. 

You will be required to read and agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use and pick a display name. 
[list]
[*][u][b]NOTE: Creating a new Warframe account via the Steam launcher will automatically bind it to the Steam account you are currently logged into. Please check to make sure you are linking the correct Steam account to the new Warframe account, as the link cannot be undone.[/b][/u]
[/list]
[b]NOTE:[/b] It’s important to keep in mind that Account Binding allows anyone to enter your Warframe account by clicking the “Login with Steam” button without having to input your credentials. We recommend that you log out of your Steam account while not in use to ensure account security – more information on how to protect your account in our [url=https://support.warframe.com/hc/en-us/articles/360043185011-Best-Practices-for-Account-Security]“Best Practices for Account Security”[/url] support article. 
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Auto Login[/h2]
Once you have bound a Warframe and Steam account, you will be able to use the new [b]Auto Login[/b] feature, which automatically signs you in and loads you into the game immediately after launching Warframe from Steam. 

[h3]How to Set Up: [/h3]
It’s as easy as clicking the [b]“Auto Login” checkbox[/b] below the “Login With Steam” button! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/371b73733c5ebfc072ea43d5a40511ca601f02a0.jpg[/img]
It can also be enabled/disabled using the “Steam Auto Login” toggle in the Social tab Options: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/b0c73c857d10bee8c3b6b34049f0c50e211d6420.jpg[/img]
[b]How to disable Auto Login:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Log out from the Esc menu by going to Profile > Log Out 
[*] Go to your Options > Social > Steam Auto Login and toggle off
[/olist]
We’re excited to bring this to our Steam Tenno with the launch of Koumei & The Five Fates!

notes.title: Devstream 181 Highlights
notes.content:
Devstream 181 was broadcast live from the Event Stage at Tokyo Game Show 2024 and included the full reveal of our next update, Koumei & the Five Fates (along with the release date of next week on October 2!). We also unveiled some new teaser art from our upcoming collaboration with The Line and announced the upcoming release of a new playable Warframe: 1999 demo on October 16.

If you weren't able to join us live, we've compiled some of the stream's most memorable highlights below. For all of the nitty-gritty details, you can also check out our official [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/devstream-181-overview]Devstream Overview[/url].

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Koumei & the Five Fates: Coming October 2[/h2]

With just a few days remaining before launch, Devstream 181 saw the premiere of the Koumei & the Five Fates Official Gameplay Trailer:

[previewyoutube=D6iblGunMnQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]58th Warframe: Koumei[/h3]
Test your luck with the Dice-Maiden, Tenno! Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/46c786584bece7353063f1faa1d3ff0675233529.jpg[/img]
[b]Passive:[/b]
Fate selects one of her weapons to impart randomized status effects when dealing damage. This passive effect swaps to another weapon after a duration.

[i]Important Note: as the Dice-Maiden, Koumei rolls 5 Dice for each Ability cast, which impacts each Ability in its own way.[/i]

[b]First Ability: Kumihimo[/b]
Weaves the threads of Destiny. Enemies who touch these threads suffer a random Status Effect.

Rolling three 6s on her Dice will spawn Threads that deal every Status Effect on contact.

[b]Second Ability: Omikuji [/b]
Koumei glimpses a favorable future and the precise steps needed to reach it. Cast the ability to uncover a challenge — completing it will reward Koumei a random Decree.

A roll of triple sixes will grant a Decree without needing to complete a challenge.

[b]Third Ability: Omamori[/b]
Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei’s dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.

[b]Fourth Ability: Bunraku[/b]
Wield your foe’s fate threads like the strings of marionettes, suspending enemies in front of Koumei. Her dice determine the number of random Status Effects dealt to affected foes.

A roll of triple sixes maximizes Status Effect stacks and extends Bunraku to enemies behind Koumei.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]New Deluxe Skins[/h3]
Adorn yourself in the delicate beauty of sakura with Nova Aozakura, or embody a mythological god of thunder with Volt Raijin. Each of these Deluxe Skins also includes Ephemeras and Signas:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/bfc327e6935aef330b06958763c31f695657929b.png[/img]
Caliban will also enjoy the Deluxe Skin treatment with the new Caliban Orfeo Collection! This otherworldly Deluxe Skin also brings the Seighe Scythe Skin and Heurodis Ephemera, pictured below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/7846f3706c31472e8d4d7ac326c019cef6c28620.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Warframe Reworks[/h3]
In addition to her graceful Deluxe Skin, Nova will also benefit from a "Light" Rework that makes minor (but welcome) improvements to her antimatter themed Abilities:

[previewyoutube=nbflcmIku7I;full][/previewyoutube]
Caliban's Rework, on the other hand, is much more robust, as Design Director Pablo Alonso explains below:

[previewyoutube=1WkXRGAM6z0;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Caliban Giveaway[/h3]
Between his extensive Rework and otherworldly Orfeo Collection, Koumei & the Five Fates is shaping up to be a fairly Caliban-heavy update! To help facilitate the ease of trying out his new changes and improvements for yourself, we'll be giving away a free base Caliban Warframe (and Warframe slot) to all Tenno who log in between October 2 and October 16. Click [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/calibans-new-adaptations]here[/url] for our full round-up of Caliban's new adaptations.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
Many of the QoL changes and New Player Experience improvements coming with Koumei & the Five Fates were already detailed in our [url=https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1413240-dev-workshop-koumei-the-five-fates-new-player-experience-and-quality-of-life]Dev Workshop[/url], but during Devstream 181 we also announced a new, streamlined login process for Steam-linked accounts, as well as an expansion to Cross Platform Trading that will allow Tenno to more freely trade and gift across different platforms.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Warframe: 1999 Demo Coming October 16[/h3]

[previewyoutube=mf439BGrze0;full][/previewyoutube]
On October 16, we’re giving all Tenno a taste of 1999! Hop into Höllvania as Arthur and battle the Scaldra atop your turbo-charged Atomicycle. This short demo will be accessible directly from your Orbiter. Complete it for yourself to earn a free Protokol Longsword Skin!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]The Line Anime Teaser[/h3]
As part of one last tease, we shared some work-in-progress images of The Hex Syndicate as seen in our collaboration with The Line. We're continuing to work closely with this incredible animation studio to produce an upcoming Warframe: 1999 short!

notes.title: Caliban's New Adaptations
notes.content:
Heir to the twin kingdoms of Tau and Sol, Caliban debuted during The New War as the very first Sentient-Warframe hybrid. True to his origins, he's recently undergone a number of dramatic adaptations for improved playability that every Tenno should know about:

[h3]Caliban Rework[/h3]

[previewyoutube=1WkXRGAM6z0;full][/previewyoutube]

Sweeping changes have been made to Caliban's Abilities — not only to increase his overall strength but also to enhance the fantasy of wielding Sentient powers. To that end, this Rework officially formalizes Tau Damage, which Caliban now deals out extensively.

Razor Gyre has become a Status-inflicting "traversal tool," while Sentient Wrath is now more in line with the Crowd Control Abilities found among other Warframes. Casting Lethal Progeny will summon new types of Sentient allies, and Fusion Strike has seen a variety of Quality of Life improvements for a more satisfying experience.

For full details, visit the [url=https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1414150-dev-workshop-koumei-the-five-fates-caliban-nova-rework]Official Warframe Forums[/url]!

[h3]Caliban Orfeo[/h3]

Inspired by the fierce devotion of his mythological namesake, Caliban Orfeo channels both the Old War and the Otherworld with an impressive (but ghastly) new Deluxe Skin. Venture forth boldly in the face of death with Caliban Orfeo, or get the complete Caliban Orfeo Collection to instantly add the Seighe Scythe Skin, Heurodis Ephemera and Heurodis Decoration to your Arsenal, as well. All are available now on the in-game Market.

[h3]Free Caliban Giveaway[/h3]

To celebrate both Caliban's highly-anticipated Rework [i]and[/i] his new Orfeo Collection, we're also offering every Tenno a FREE Caliban Warframe (including an accompanying Warframe Slot and pre-installed Orokin Reactor). [b]To earn yours, simply log into Warframe between 11:30 a.m. ET on October 2 and October 16 at 11:59 p.m. ET to claim him from your Inbox![/b]

[h3]WHAT IS TENNOGEN?[/h3]
For newer Tenno who might not be familiar, TennoGen refers to Warframe content created by Tenno, for Tenno. Talented artists from the Warframe community are able to submit their own unique designs for Weapon Skins, Armor, Warframe Skins and more.

[h3]HOW DOES THE SUBMISSION PROCESS WORK?[/h3]
Check out our [url=​​https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1289151-steam-workshop-faq-start-here]TennoGen FAQ[/url] for all the information you need to get started.

Design submissions are reviewed by Digital Extremes’ internal art department and, if selected, are implemented directly into Warframe! The TennoGen artist involved then receives a 30% revenue share on the Steam sale of their creation(s). So, by adding TennoGen items to your Arsenal, you’re helping to directly support community artists!

[h3]WHERE CAN I FIND IT?[/h3]
If you play Warframe on PC, you can discover stunning TennoGen content directly through Steam! If you play on console, you’ll be able to find TennoGen content through the in-game Market, available for Platinum.

Complete four limited-time Alerts to earn Credits, Nakak Pearls and new Rewards, including:

[h3]Suplex Kubrow Glyph[/h3]
[i]That’s the bottom line ‘cause Kubrow said so.[/i]

[h3]Dog Days WAR Display[/h3]
[i]We've got two words for ya: Soak it![/i]

[h3]Dropkick Drahk Emblem[/h3]
[i]You know what The Drahk is cooking.[/i]

[i]Give your dirty floors Hell and your Orbiter some hardcore edge.[/i]
