notes.title: PSA - SteamInput Controller Issues
notes.content:
Hi Tenno,

For those of you who use controllers on the Steam client for Warframe, we are aware of some issues relating to controller inputs. With Echoes of Duviri’s launch, we did post a clarification on how to fix lost controller support for those experiencing it, found here: [url=https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1361266-lost-controller-support-on-pc/#comment-12839111 ]https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1361266-lost-controller-support-on-pc/#comment-12839111 [/url].

For ease of reference, the comment reads:
[quote=DEGlen][W]e just updated the Recommended Official Layouts (we couldn't do this until we'd released the update and there was some difficulty getting them ported over from our Test cluster).

If you're using Steam Input for Warframe (ie: for a PS4 or Steam Controller that doesn't work with the native XInput) restart Steam to refresh the list, edit your Warframe Controller settings in steam, select a layout, and you should see an updated recommended layouts for Playstation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Steam, and Steam Deck controllers now: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/e04d53a2ebe44c895fcc2f88bbd3601beb16fdb5.png[/img]
[/quote]

[b]Further Issues Following Each Update:[/b]

If you are seeing [b]custom controls being reset with our hotfixes[/b], this is due to us publishing fixes for SteamInput, which invalidates custom layouts. We have been actively working on SteamInput (and by extension, SteamDeck) changes but excluded them from our patch notes until we had more news about the status on ongoing issues for our SteamDeck players* -- with that said, we understand that this decision may have led to even more player confusion.

To recap the fixes done to the SteamInput system over the past week:

[i]Echoes of Duviri: Hotfix 33.6.1[/i]
[list]
    [*] Fixed Archwing blink when using Steam Input.
[/list]
[i]Echoes of Duviri: Hotfix 33.6.3[/i]
[list]
    [*] Fixed Shawzin inputs not functioning properly with Steam Input. 
[/list]
As for [b]further Steam Input fixes[/b], we usually like to get you fixes ASAP however, because of the way Steam Input works, almost every fix we make will invalidate all customized layouts. [b]As a result, we're trying to bundle up as many fixes as possible before sending out another update.[/b]

 
[i]* For our SteamDeck players, we are actively working with Valve to resolve various issues. Once we are closer to a resolution on these, we will post a separate PSA pertaining to that situation. Thank you for your patience on this matter! [/i]

notes.title: PSA - Steam Deck Login Issues (RESOLVED)
notes.content:
Tenno,

We are aware of issues for the Warframe Steam Deck client as a result of the August Steam Deck System Update. Upon installing, the On Screen Keyboard no longer appears to let you enter your login details, preventing players from being able to log-in.

At this time, we recommend you avoid updating your Steam Deck to the August Steam Deck System Update until we find a resolution for this issue. We have contacted Valve and are looking for a solution with them. We’ll update this announcement as more information comes in.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

EDIT: A temporary workaround has been discovered with the following steps:
[list]
[*] Launch your Steamdeck in desktop mode
[*] Open the Steam app
[*] Switch to Big Picture Mode (monitor symbol top right)
[*] Launch Warframe
[/list]

[strike][b]UPDATE: August 3 @ 2pm[/b]

We have heard back from Valve that they have identified an issue and are looking for a fix. [/strike]

[h3][b]UPDATE: August 4 @ 10am[/b][/h3]

Valve has put out a hotfix for SteamDeck users and functionality as been restired. Please apply the update in order to see the changes. It may not automatically search for the update so below are instructions to manually install it.

[olist]
[*] Steam button
[*] Settings > System
[*] "Check for Updates"
[*] You should see a new software update!
[/olist]

notes.title: Echoes of Duviri
notes.content:
Jump back into the mind-bending open world of Duviri for an ancillary update featuring new QOL changes plus an iconic boss battle deep within the subterranean confines of the Undercroft!

[h3]THE JACKAL RETURNS[/h3]
No longer limited by the industrial walls of a Corpus laboratory, the Jackal can now be found roaming the eerie sub-realm beneath Duviri: the Undercroft. Take on this famous Warframe boss in a new Assassination game mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/297df63d85a3592531629254761a2588129a04f8.png[/img]
Please note: this version of the Jackal fight has been modified from its original form on Venus. You’ll need to battle the Jackal through three phases (instead of four), and will have to deal with reinforcements between each phase.

[h3]NEW UNDERCROFT TILESETS[/h3]
Two new tiles have been added to the Undercroft: the large, open spaces of the [b]Fractal Pastures[/b] as well as the calming [b]Amphitheatre[/b]. All five existing game modes can be experienced through both of these exciting new areas with the Jackal appearing exclusively on Fractal Pastures to wreak havoc on the crops.

[h3]THE ETHEREAL WARFRAME, PRIMED[/h3]
Now entering Prime Access: the interdimensional enchantress, [b]Wisp Prime[/b].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/warframeprime/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/672b4e08dfd913e3952530aa7862bdcced703742.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/warframeprime/]Instantly acquire[/url] the latest Prime Warframe along with her signature Prime Weapons, Fulmin Prime and Gunsen Prime, plus new Prime Accessories, Resource and Affinity Boosters and more.

[h3]NEW DRIFTER MELEE: ARGO & VEL[/h3]
Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Gain instant access to this powerful Melee weaponry (for use with both Drifter and Warframe) with Platinum, available from either Teshin’s Cave or the in-game Market. Alternatively, you can unlock each weapon with Pathos Clamps for Drifter use and then gain its Blueprint to craft in your Foundry for use with your preferred Warframe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/e56f24aa774d7122848147b45c4c83f827818c00.png[/img]
[h3]DOMESTIK DAIS DRONE[/h3]
Available through the Void Trader, Baro Ki'Teer, this diligent drone is sure to keep your home and/or Orbiter spotless — whether you’re a commoner or a king!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/0d518ba0467ef27bbbc033b132ca2fb93d1d274f.png[/img]
[h3]NEW INCARNON GENESES[/h3]
You can now earn new Incarnon Geneses via the Circuit Steel Path! Once acquired, these can be installed into their applicable weapons by visiting Cavalero aboard the Zariman.

[code][b]Boar (base and Prime)[/b]
Awaken this weapon’s ability to fire three short-range beams that chain link enemies in Incarnon Form.

[b]Gammacor (base and Synoid)[/b]
Awaken this weapon’s ability to fire projectiles that pull enemies into a Cold Damage explosion in Incarnon Form.

[b]Angstrum (base and Prisma)[/b]
Awaken this weapon’s ability to launch target-seeking fireballs that ricochet toward enemies in Incarnon Form.

[b]Gorgon (base, Wraith, and Prisma)[/b]
Awaken this weapon’s ability to fire embedding projectiles that explode with Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.

[b]Anku[/b]
Awaken this weapon’s ability to increase Range and Slash Damage during slide attacks in Incarnon Form.
[/code]
[h3]NEW DECREES[/h3]
New Decrees have been added to the randomized pool of options upon completing Duviri Spiral stages and side objectives!

[code][b]Stable Stance[/b]
Gains 25% resistance to knockdown for each enemy within 20m.

[b]Swooping Miasma[/b]
Gain +3 jumps. Jumping slide kicks cause 300 Viral Damage and status in an area around hit enemies.

[b]Kexat’s Pounce[/b]
Jump higher. Gain +180% damage while airborne. Effect wears off 2s after landing.

[b]Baneful Harmony[/b]
Inflicting Cold or Toxin status effects also inflicts Viral status.

[b]Consuming Rage (Spiteful)[/b]
Heavy Attacks and Power Strikes consume 10% of Energy or Transference Bar, but gain +300% damage.
[/code]
[h3]NEW WARFRAME AUGMENT MODS[/h3]
Acquire new Warframe Augment Mods through Syndicate Offerings:

[code][b]Temporal Erosion (Protea - Temporal Anchor)[/b]
While Temporal Anchor is active, each strike of Grenade Fan and Blaze Artillery strips 10% Armor from enemies.

[b]Shadow Haze (Sevagoth - Reap)[/b]
Increase Critical Chance by 50% on enemies inflicted with Death Harvest. A new Shadow emerges from those enemies when they perish. Limit of 3 Shadows.

[b]Ulfrun’s Endurance (Voruna - Ulfrun’s Descent)[/b]
During Ulfrun’s attack, enemies that die from Bleed within 20m restores Voruna’s charges.

[b]Intrepid Stand (Styanax - Final Stand)[/b]
Each javelin that hits an enemy grants 60 Overguard to Styanax and 30 Overguard to his allies within Affinity Range.
[/code]
[h3]QOL CHANGES[/h3]
First announced in the recent [url=https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1361071-echoes-of-duviri-community-qol-improvements-changes/?ct=1690232142]Dev Workshop[/url], changes have been made to the following systems:

[list][*] Enhanced Damage Numbers
[*] Overguard for Warframes
[*] Cold, Impact, and Puncture Status[/list]
Check out the video below for a quick explanation of the changes to Damage Numbers, courtesy of [b]Lead Designer Pablo Alonso:[/b]

[previewyoutube=eOEu4ny3RWM;full][/previewyoutube]
As always, be sure to check out our [url=https://www.warframe.com/updates/pc/33-6-0]patch notes[/url] for full details on the changes and additions listed above.

Good luck on your latest foray into Duviri, Tenno!

notes.title: TennoCon 2023 Schedule Revealed
notes.content:
This summer is heating up as the fires of conflict once again rage across the Origin System. Yet quelling the chaos also brings an opportunity to celebrate — and earn great rewards.

Today on Devstream 172, the crew led by Community Director Megan Everett outlined the continued celebration of Warframe’s 10-year anniversary in the form of upcoming Alerts featuring classic enemies. Meanwhile, you can look forward to slightly less dangerous festivities at TennoCon 2023 with its newly revealed schedule. Finally, whether you’re facing down death or indulging your inner fashionista, you can look forward to the release date for Wisp Prime as well as a free Dex Operator and Drifter Skin

In case you missed the Devstream live, or just need a refresher, check out all the TennoCon details right here!

[url=https://www.warframe.com/tennocon][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/9feace4d0f0aecf2eb3ede09421ced80cd245cc1.png[/img][/url]

[h2]TENNOCON 2023 MAIN STAGE SCHEDULE[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Our annual celebration of all things Warframe continues with the first in-person event in three years. While physical tickets are sold out, you can still view the event via livestream on YouTube, Twitch and Steam for all the biggest announcements and behind-the-scenes intrigue. The daylong event begins on Saturday, August 26, 2023!

[h3]ET: Welcome to TennoCon 2023[/h3]
[b]12:30 p.m. ET:[/b] Welcome to TennoCon 2023 with… the Welcome to TennoCon 2023 preshow! Hosts Megan Everett and Rebecca Ford will kick off the day with one last rundown of events, giveaways and more!

[h3]The Art of Warframe[/h3]
[b]1 p.m. ET:[/b] Join host Megan Everett as she leads members of the Digital Extremes art team — Geoff Crookes, Kaz Adams, Kary Black, Keith Thompson and Eric Vedder — on a behind-the-scenes tour of the many colorful sights built into the backbone of Warframe. There might even be a few exclusive premieres, like the world’s first in-depth look at the upcoming “Halloween-themed” Warframe and other reveals.

[h3]Sounds of the System[/h3]
[b]2 p.m. ET:[/b] Community Live Ops Manager Taylor King talks to Erich Preston, George Spanos and Matt Chalmers from the sound team about how the incredible (and instantly recognizable) sounds of Warframe get made. Learn more about your favorite songs and Grineer grunts than ever before!

[h3]Cosplay & Community Art Show[/h3]
[b]3 p.m. ET:[/b] Join us as our beloved Cosplay Show and Art Contest returns! Hosted by Community Developer Helen Heikkilä, come see a showcase of the extremely talented Warframe Community — ranging from cosplay to digital art to video!

[h3]TennoLive 2023[/h3]
[b]4:30 p.m.[/b] You absolutely don’t want to miss this: the day’s biggest event! TennoLive is the perennial capstone to TennoCon, with all the biggest Warframe reveals of the year. That includes a world-first look at our next major expansion, plans for the future and beyond.

Remember the first time you saw The Plains of Eidolon? How about the spacefaring Railjacks, the bizarre roguelike action of Duviri, or the Infested world of Deimos? That’s the level of reveal you can witness this year all over again or for the first time ever. Whether you’re attending live or watching from home!

notes.title: Recall: Ten-Zero
notes.content:
The next phase of our 10-Year Anniversary begins July 19 with Recall: Ten-Zero!

Recall: Ten-Zero is a retrospective look at some of the biggest moments in Warframe, and gives you a chance to relive them with weekly Alerts commemorating unforgettable boss fights, enemies and stories.

Earn exclusive weekly rewards with each Alert leading up to [url="https://www.warframe.com/tennocon"][b]TennoCon 2023[/b][/url] on August 26! Those who complete three full weeks of Alerts will receive a 10-Year Anniversary Emblem, while those who finish all five weeks will get the new Kyndryn Gunblade Skin for use on any Gunblade.

Each group of weekly Alerts will grant you a Glyph related to that week’s theme, as well as a new Noggle and valuable Resource or Item! Unlike traditional Alerts, these Recall: Ten-Zero Alerts are replayable, but only the third Mission in each weekly sequence will grant a new Reward. (The first two Missions in each sequence will not grant repeatable rewards.)

[url=https://www.warframe.com/anniversary][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/116ef9c0bc69ec9a06d7104a47f65e478e0cbbca.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Week 1: Vor’s Prize [/h3]
[b]July 19 at 11 a.m. ET - July 27 at 11 a.m. ET[/b]
Reward: Darvo Noggle, Orokin Catalyst Blueprint, Vor Recall Glyph

Wake up, Tenno! You’re not dreaming… Vor is back. Take him down and make him wish he never disturbed your cryo-sleep.

[h3]Week 2: Enemy Factions[/h3]
[b]July 27 at 11 a.m. ET - August 3 at 11 a.m. ET[/b]
Reward: Nightwatch Grineer Lancer Noggle, Orokin Reactor Blueprint, Factions Recall Glyph

Take down the iconic Enemy factions besieging the Origin System in their signature Mission types to complete this Alert, Tenno! Grineer, Corpus, and Infested: none are safe from your Warframe and Weapons.

[h3]Week 3: Nightwave[/h3]
[b]August 3 at 11 a.m. ET - August 10 at 11 a.m. ET[/b]
Reward: Nihil Noggle, Forma, Nihil Recall Glyph

Get ready to hit rewind, Dreamers. Take a walk down memory lane with some of the greatest foes to come out of Nightwave.

[h3]Week 4: Historic Tactical Alerts[/h3]
[b]August 10 at 11 a.m. ET - August 17 at 11 a.m. ET[/b]
Reward: Exilus Warframe Adapter, Manic Noggle, Jack O’Naut Recall Glyph

You may recognize these Alerts from events and TacAlerts of old, Tenno! Take on the challenge and banish them back into the dark once more.

[h3]Week 5: Iconic Bosses[/h3]
[b]August 17 at 11 a.m. ET - August 25 at 11 a.m. ET[/b]
Reward: Jackal Noggle, Exilus Weapon Adapter, Regor Recall Glyph

[hr][/hr]
These foes won’t go down without a serious fight! Battle iconic bosses from throughout the Origin System once again for even more Recall: Ten-Zero rewards.

We hope you enjoy Recall: Ten-Zero as we count down to [url="https://www.warframe.com/tennocon"][b]TennoCon 2023[/b][/url] and commemorate our 10-Year Anniversary. The whole team can’t wait to show you what’s in store for the future of Warframe this year at TennoLive on August 26!

notes.title: The Seven Crimes of Kullervo
notes.content:
You’re invited to return to the mind-bending stage of Duviri for the next act in The Duviri Paradox… Prepare to uncover The Seven Crimes of Kullervo, available now on all platforms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/424840f1454d2182e02337f5dd74a1389abaaab6.png[/img]

[h3]NEW WARFRAME: KULLERVO[/h3]
Deep within the confines of a sprawling island dungeon, the tragic Warframe, Kullervo, awaits your redemption. Explore the prison’s cells to learn of his misdeeds and wield the power of treachery through his trademark daggers and thirst for vengeance. Unleash Kullevo’s signature Shotgun, Rauta, to increase your Melee Combo count with every successful shot. When wielded by Kullervo himself, your Melee Combo duration is also extended.  Modify your Fashion Frame with his signature Customizations — including the Kullervo Usvah Helmet and Ahlto Syandana — then master his Melee proficiency with the magnificent Vaenn Heavy Blade Skin. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/7a9ed69bd32e8cea8a7d580d0e3b75b3ea691553.png[/img]
[h3]ABILITIES[/h3]
[code][b]Passive: Whispers of Vaenn[/b]
Kullervo boasts increased Heavy Attack Efficiency and Heavy Attack Wind Up Speed on all Melee weapons.

[b]Wrathful Advance:[/b]
(TAP) Kullervo charges a Heavy Attack then teleports to his target and strikes. His rage-filled focus temporarily increases his Critical Chance.
(HOLD) Teleport to any marked location.

[b]Recompense:[/b]
Kullervo surrounds himself with daggers. Each dagger that strikes an enemy restores his health, but each dagger that misses an enemy strikes Kullervo, dealing a bit of damage. When Kullervo has max Health, he receives Overguard from struck enemies.

[b]Collective Curse:[/b]
Kullervo sends forth a curse that binds enemies. When a cursed enemy takes damage, every other cursed enemy also suffers a portion of that damage.

[b]Storm of Ukko:[/b]
The Void answers Kullervo’s invocation with a storm of daggers that rain down upon his enemies.
[/code]
[h3]NEW DUVIRI ISLAND & TIME-LIMITED EVENT: KULLERVO’S HOLD[/h3]
A new fortress-island has appeared in Duviri, begging you to dive in and discover its secrets. This strange, floating prison obfuscates both Kullervo’s crimes as well as the mysterious (yet familiar) Warden who binds him under lock and key. Unravel the sins of this tormented Warframe and earn his Blueprints by squaring off in a showdown of epic proportions!

Kullervo’s Hold will be accessible from the Duviri Star Chart on June 21 at 12 p.m. ET to July 5 at 12 p.m. ET. During this special introductory window, you will have guaranteed access to the island and boss fight to begin adding Kullervo to your Arsenal. 

Immediately after the event window ends on July 5, Kullervo’s Hold will reappear on Duviri during any Sorrow, Fear or Anger Spiral. Meanwhile, chapters of Kullervo’s story have a chance to occur as main or side objectives during any Sorrow, Fear or Anger Spiral.

[h3]RETURN TO THE UNDERCROFT[/h3]
Enter a new boss battle that might seem familiar to more experienced Tenno. Keep your eyes peeled for a surprise visitor during Undercroft Exterminate Missions!

You’ll also find that previously-locked Undercroft portals have become accessible to those who have acquired at least seven Decrees. Upon entering these gateways, your experience in the Undercroft will offer more challenges – and also greater Rewards.

[h3]CAPTAIN VOR ARRIVES IN THE UNDERCROFT[/h3]
While traversing the Undercroft, you may confront one of the Tenno’s oldest foes. Captain Vor is now a guaranteed spawn during Exterminate missions in the Undercroft — including those in The Circuit, Spiral stories, and new side objective Undercroft Portals.

His health increases for each additional member in the squad, providing additional challenge to both groups and solo players, as he must be defeated to complete the Undercroft mission.

In return for besting your familiar adversary, Captain Vor will drop Rune Marrow with an additional chance to drop his very own Vor Sigil.


[h2]NEW DUVIRI EXPERIENCE SIDE OBJECTIVES[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]KAITHE RACING RETURNS[/h3]
Put your riding skills to the test! Mount your Kaithe and race across the terrain and sky to clear gates and complete your goal in record time. Kaithe Races can appear as a Spiral stage and side objective in The Duviri Experience (both solo and co-op).

[h3]RECOVER THE PARAGRIMM'S TOMES[/h3]
Gaze through the eyes of a Paragrimm to find Tomes and mark them for collection. Finding all the required targets will reward you with Duviri Resources, Drifter Intrinsics and a Decree. Recovering Paragrimm Tomes is available only in The Duviri Experience (solo and co-op).

[h3]RETRIEVE LOST BELONGINGS[/h3]
Scour the caves of Duviri’s underbelly to find the Lost Belongings of the citizens of Duviri! Keep an eye out for Liminus, who are keen on keeping these items for themselves. Collecting all the Lost Belongings will reward you more Duviri Resources, 3x Drifter Intrinsics, and a Decree! Like Kaithe Races, Lost Belongings objectives can appear as a main Spiral stage and as a side objective.

[h3]NEW DECREES[/h3]
With 15 powerful new Decrees, you’ll find more variety than ever in your Duviri runs. Test your skills and builds with Spiteful Decrees such as Fragile Vanity, which reduces 50% of current Armor while adding Damage from players’ shots that proportionally increases based on the Armor remaining.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/7783305469eafee37ec25a2f87ab5030d97bb0d8.jpg[/img]
[h3]DUVIRI RESOURCE EXTRACTING: SPROUT[/h3]
You can now collect Duviri plant Resources from the comfort of Teshin’s Cave with the new [b]SPROUT[/b] (Self-Perpetuating Regular Operation for Utilizing Terrain) system.

Every 20 hours, six random plants from Duviri will grow and mature for harvesting in Teshin’s Cave. Simply approach the planters located in the room between your Kaithe and the mirror to cultivate Resources from these fully-grown plants.

The growth timer resets once you collect the resources from Teshin’s Cave. Check back once the plants have matured again to harvest, rinse and repeat!

notes.title: The Duviri Paradox Primer
notes.content:
[h3] Choose your Path [/h3] [hr][/hr]If you're new, after you log in for the first time you'll be presented with a choice between two paths: Warframe Path or Paradox Path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978945/63f5e07f14294f48f173758467d1a460056d50fb.jpg[/img]

[h3]The[b] Paradox Path[/b] is the newest expansion to Warframe, letting you experience The Duviri Paradox right away, without needing to complete any prerequisites. This way you can play the newest content in Warframe and then approach the rest of the game at your own pace![/h3]

[b]Warframe Path[/b] is the traditional path that you would have experienced before the launch of The Duviri Paradox. It follows the cinematic Quest line starting with Awakening into Vor's Prize, after which you will be able to play Duviri or jump right into the Star Chart to defend the Origin System. 

[h3]Spirals[/h3] [hr][/hr]In Duviri, time does not flow in a straight line, instead looping in on itself to create a never-ending cycle of life, death and rebirth. These cycles are known as [b]Spirals[/b] in Duviri and they will form the foundation of your adventures. Each Spiral will have a mood determined by Dominus Thrax's outlook for that Spiral. These moods can change everything from the stories and objectives you'll encounter to the damage type that Enemies can inflict! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978945/48fe5934a2ea195499914b611181d053a9f0c4ca.gif[/img]

During a Spiral you can complete objectives and side activities to collect Decrees, which upgrade your power for that Spiral and enhance your play style. Different Decrees have different effects ranging anywhere from more damage to increased mobility to unique bonuses that grant extra utility in or out of combat! Choosing the right Decrees for that Spiral could mean the difference between life and death so choose wisely, Tenno! 

You'll also be able to earn and select Intrinsics for the Drifter in Teshin's Cave that persist between Spirals. This lets you steadily grow your power across repeated adventures in Duviri! 

[h3] 3 Ways to play Duviri [/h3][hr][/hr]After you've completed the Duviri Paradox Quest, you'll have the opportunity to return to Duviri in one of three ways. Each choice has a unique experience with its own gameplay and rewards! No matter which way you choose to play, your journey in Duviri will begin in Teshin's Cave, where you can pick your Loadout, customize Drifter Intrinsics, customize your Kaithe and more! [list]

[*] [b]The Lone Story[/b]
The Lone Story is a streamlined version of Duviri with only the Spiral story for Tenno looking to face the Orowyrm as quickly as possible. [/list][list]
[*] [b]The Duviri Experience[/b]
Duviri as it is meant to be played – the Open World experience with a story that reflects the current Spiral, along with side activities like Maw Feeding, Kaithe racing, and open exploration. Take full advantage of everything Duviri has to offer with this game mode, Tenno.[/list][list]
[*] [b]The Circuit[/b]
The Circuit revolves around endless gameplay Objectives set in The Undercroft, amongst the very roots of Duviri. Pick your difficulty and reward track, complete rounds to fill out the track and claim rewards as you complete Objectives! Rewards will rotate weekly to make each delve into the Undercroft unique. [/list]
With that, you should be all set to dive into The Duviri Paradox and make the most of each and every adventure! Best of luck surviving the Spirals and moods of the dangerous child king, Dominus Thrax, Tenno. You'll need it if you ever hope to escape the Paradox once and for all!

notes.title: Warframe's Duviri Paradox update is courting newcomers to the MMO with its standalone story world
notes.content:
Long-running sci-fi MMO Warframe has just released its biggest update yet, The Duviri Paradox, for free. In other words, this is a new experience within Warframe that’s immediately available to newcomers, while also adding weird cool stuff for old-timers.

notes.title: Warframe's next major update The Duviri Paradox is launching April 26
notes.content:
Warframe is getting another major update this month, as the Duviri Paradox is launching on PC, Xbox, PlayStation and Switch on April 26.

The update, which is a massive open world experience that adds a new rogue-like style quest, had previously been delayed for mysterious reasons. Soon, those who had been eager to jump in earlier in the year will be able to experience new story developments, gameplay mechanics, and all manner of unlockable stuff.

The Duviri Paradox is seemingly split between two paths: one where you play as your original character or one that sees you playing as The Drifter as they both experience different routes through the new content. You'll be able to play both regardless of your initial choice, but it certainly does point towards some interesting story developments with this update. As a rule of thumb, if The Drifter is involved, things are bound to get interesting.

Read more

notes.title: Citrine’s Last Wish Available Now!
notes.content:
A new Warframe arrives in the Origin System, as beautiful and deadly as the fractal gems that she wields in combat! Experience a brand new Mission type that has you defending objectives connected by the Void on both Mars and Venus, and add Citrine as well as her signature new Weapons to your Arsenal in Citrine’s Last Wish.

[h2]New Warframe: Citrine[/h2]
Gaze upon the Crystal Bastion. Citrine’s crystalline might supports allies on the battlefield and combat only enhances her fractal beauty. Pick up the new Crystal Bastion Collection on launch day in the Market or earn Citrine Blueprints in the new Mirror Defense Mission!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/5235ad856d2bc50d0eb36b319767075b51eeba06.png[/img]

Crystal Bastion Collection features:
[code][list]
[*] Citrine Warframe
[*] Citrine Kalite Helmet
[*] Steflos Shotgun
[*] Corufell
[*] Alumeti Sugatra
[*] Citrine Sigil
[*] Belric and Rania Reunited Ship Decoration
[/list][/code]
Instead of a Leverian, you can reveal Citrine’s origins by visiting Otak in the Necralisk on Deimos and by playing the new Tyana Pass Mission on Mars. Citrine’s Prex Card can also be obtained from Otak.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/a1a80de2efda78da59cf989a394df447d310cc21.png[/img]
[h2]Abilities[/h2]

[b]Passive: Geoluminesence [/b]
When Citrine picks up a Health Orb, an aura surrounds her that steadily provides additional health over time.

[b]Fractured Blast: [/b]
Slash and stagger enemies with a crystal blast that inflicts Bleed. Enemies afflicted with this Status Effect have an increased chance of dropping Health and Energy Orbs.. *Fractured Blast is Citrine’s Helminth Ability at 50% strength.

[b]Preserving Shell[/b]
Citrine guards herself and nearby allies with a crystalline shell that gradually decays. Kills and assists increase the defensive power of the shell.

[b]Prismatic Gem[/b]
Deploy a gem that shoots prismatic beams. The gem targets enemies that are taking weapon damage from Citrine and her allies. Its beams inflict Heat, Cold, Toxin, and Electricity Status Effects. Status Chance and Status Duration increase for nearby allies. *Prismatic Gem is Citrine’s Railjack ability - can be used to deploy a geode via the Tactical Menu.

[b]Crystallize[/b]
Citrine summons crystal fractals. The fractals rush forward, seeking enemies. Enemies touched by the fractals are paralyzed by crystalline growths. Hit the growths to deal increased damage.

[h2]New Mission Node: Tyana Pass[/h2]
Defend lovers encased in crystal on both Mars and Venus in one Mission! In response to the connection between Belric and Rania, The Void has bored a hole in space to connect their preserved bodies for eternity.

However, the Grineer and Corpus won’t sit idly by, and they are already descending upon the tunnel and crystals to try and harness their power for themselves. It’s up to the Tenno to use the mysterious Void tunnel between worlds to defend Rania’s Crystal on Mars and Belric’s Crystal on Venus.

Collect Citrine’s Remnants found throughout the area to further crystallize the two lovers, restoring their Health and awakening the defensive Prismatic Ward.

As your reward, you’ll receive new Resources, the Belric & Rania Fragments as well as Blueprints for Citrine, new Weapons Blueprints for the Steflos and Corufell and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/ac2780144d34954a8b431317ea809b16c9652591.png[/img]
[h2]New Customizations: Drifter Visage Ink[/h2]
Adorn your Drifter with expressive body art designs to showcase your unique style! When Citrine’s Last Wish launches, you can find 3 new Visage Ink Collections in the Market or get the full variety of Visage Ink instantly with the Multiform Visage Ink Bundle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/8841fda679d4594d1f56773a446703aa0c79534f.png[/img]
[h2]Rhino Deathwatch Skin [/h2]
Become a harbinger of death and stretch your wings with the Rhino Deathwatch Skin. Complete with the Rhino Deathwatch Wings auxiliary attachment, you can find this iridescent Warframe Skin in the Market!

Or if customizable Voidshell Skins are more your style, turn the heat up on your Fashion Frame with the new Ember Voidshell Skin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/97151f7130161ec9b710cde831e9016afd706b66.png[/img]

The star of the show is, as you could imagine, Citrine! Obtained alongside a host of new weapons through the new Mirror Defence mission type, a spin on the classic format where you must protect a selection of crystalline lovers from waves of incoming enemies.

notes.title: Lua’s Prey Revealed
notes.content:
It’s going to be an exciting winter, Tenno!

Today during Devstream 165, Community Director Megan Everett and the Devstream crew announced a number of important developments regarding the future of the Origin System. Crucially, they revealed a new update coming later this year, as well as a new timeline for the release of the highly-anticipated The Duviri Paradox.

In case you missed it, we’ve got all the details for you below.

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/49f05682146481b7c96c9c6a04637974.png[/img]

[h3]THE STATE OF DUVIRI[/h3]

The Duviri Paradox is currently deep in development, and will ultimately include even more unique features than those announced during TennoCon 2022! However, in order to make this the strongest update possible, we’ve made the decision to delay its release until 2023. With Duviri shaping up to be very different from our previous open worlds, this additional development time will help us deliver the experience you deserve.

In light of this news, Winter 2022 will see the release of a new update…

[h3]LUA’S PREY[/h3]

The upcoming Lua’s Prey update will finally allow you to take control of the long-awaited, wolf-inspired Warframe, Voruna! Originally scheduled for release as part The Duviri Paradox, Voruna will instead be making an early debut alongside her signature Weapons, Alt Helmet, Ephemera, and Voidshell Skin. Plus, keep an eye out for her new Leverian entry!

[h3]OTHER FEATURES:[/h3]

A soft prequel to Duviri, Lua’s Prey also introduces a number of other features, including a new area on Lua where you’ll take on the Conjunction Survival gamemode, Xaku Deluxe, a new Lotus Skin, Nightwave: Nora’s Mix Vol. 3, new Voidshell Skins and more.

In addition to Lua’s prey, our Cross Platform play testing is continuing with more to come as we integrate additional platforms and features. A full, working Cross Save system is currently targeted for release in 2023.

notes.title: Available Now: Veilbreaker
notes.content:
[h3]The Return of Kahl-175 and the 50th Warframe debut[/h3]

[previewyoutube=LueYL4Da9Rc;full][/previewyoutube]
Veilbreaker brings more opportunities to be the savior of the Origin System as the legendary Grineer hero from The New War, Kahl-175, returns in this explosive Update and Quest, live now on all platforms.

Alongside Veilbreaker comes Styanax, the 50th Warframe—a mythic warrior of shield and spear. In celebration of this huge milestone in the growth of Warframe’s roster, you will get Styanax free for a limited time just by logging in before September 21!

In Veilbreaker’s new single-player Quest, battle your way through an onslaught of Sentient enemies with Kahl’s iconic armaments. Then experience all-new weekly Missions in upcoming Garrison Assignments that will create opportunities to upgrade and customize Kahl to become an unstoppable Grineer hero. Return to your chosen Warframe to face off against the unbridled wrath of Archons with your Squad in all-new Archon Hunts! To survive these deadly new bosses, you’ll need all the power you can get. Fortunately, you can instantly wield the might of Styanax just by logging in at launch.

[h3]Styanax Collection[/h3]

In addition to claiming Styanax for free by logging in before September 21, you can also customize your Warframe with a set of heroically fashionable Accessories!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/64e5a0313b04e8e0fefab5074c12175811e40cc8.png[/img]

The Styanax Gallantry Collection features:
[code]Styanax Voidshell Skin (and Fieldron Form Material Structure)
Styanax Synmora Helmet
Styanax Agogean Helmet
Lanex Syandana
Tharros & Axios Decoration[/code]
Plus, you can add Styanax’s signature Speargun, the Afentis, to your Arsenal by purchasing it for Platinum in the in-game Market.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/9e8d7af843ad955f96fe7c297e5ce8a773524689.png[/img]

[h3]Kahl's Garrison[/h3]
Next week, after you have completed the Veilbreaker Quest, you’ll gain access to Kahl’s Garrison, a new Syndicate arriving with Veilbreaker.

You can find Kahl’s Garrison at the Drifter Camp, where you can earn Customizations for Kahl and much more. Earning Stock and ranking up in Kahl’s Garrison will reward you with more options!

In the coming weeks, you’ll be able to return to Kahl-175 after completing the Veilbreaker Quest via new weekly Missions in which you’ll continue to liberate your brothers and fight against Narmer. Complete these Missions to earn additional Stock for Kahl’s Garrison.

Stay tuned for more information on when you can access Kahl’s weekly Missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/938a8160b9d04d1b499b5c541eb65c76e2659de8.png[/img]

[h3]Archon Hunts[/h3]
Kahl needs your help to take down the Archons, Tenno! Starting September 11, the location of an Archon will be revealed to you each week. Hunt the toughest enemies Narmer can muster in a series of three challenging Missions with modifiers to put your loadouts and skills to the test.

Complete all three missions of an Archon Hunt and you’ll be rewarded with an Archon Shard! Each Archon gives a different Shard (Azure, Crimson, or Amber) and each Shard has a chance to be Tauforged, granting it extra power.

Use the Helminth aboard your Orbiter to install Archon Shards into your Warframe and grant permanent stat upgrades depending on the type of Shard used. Azure Shards grant defensive stats, while Crimson gives offensive stats and Amber will give your Warframes additional utility. Each Warframe has 5 Archon Shard slots for you to experiment with and find the combination that best fits your playstyle!

[h3]Veilbreaker Supporter Pack[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2061924/Warframe_Veilbreaker_Warrior_Pack/

Stand by your brothers in arms and defend the defenseless with the items in this pack.

The Veilbreaker Warrior Pack features:[code]
- 350 Platinum
- Slaytra Machete
- Afentis Speargun
- Ascension Speargun Skin
- Aegrit Thrown Weapon
- Fog of War Ephemera
- Kahl's Fortitude Sigil
- For My Brothers Glyph
- Noggle Statue - Kahl-175
- 7-Day Affinity Booster
- 7-Day Credit Booster[/code]
This pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.

[h3]QoL Changes[/h3]

Not only will Veilbreaker bring even more ways to be a hero, but it also includes a multitude of Quality of Life improvements including essential Warframe reworks of abilities and mechanics on Excalibur, Volt, Mag and more. Additionally we have been making Ammo, Armor, Riven Collection and Syndicate Pledge improvements, along with even more Warframe Augment Buffs! There are plenty more QoL changes being introduced to Veilbreaker, so stay tuned to all of our channels to learn more.

[h3]Voidshell Skins[/h3]

Introduced in Angels of the Zariman, Voidshell Skins open up a world of new Customization options by letting Tenno also change the texture and material type of their favorite Warframes, and more are coming with Veilbreaker! Encapsulate the power of the Void and don these brand-new morphing materials on Excalibur, Wukong, Nova, and Styanax!

[h3]Protea Caladrius Collection[/h3]

The deadly, gadget-wielding Protea gets the Deluxe treatment in Veilbreaker with the bold Protea Caladrius Collection. This all-new collection includes the Protea Caladrius Skin – inspired by the caladrius bird of Roman mythology, the Daecret Tonkor Skin, Monitivus Throwing Bombs Skin, and the Ascension Speargun Skin. Get ready to dominate the battlefield in this unique alternative look for Protea!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/13c57c06029e0d413b9076a6a8bae9b01ed83879.jpg[/img]

[h3]TennoGen Round 22: Part 2[/h3]

Recently we released some jaw-dropping community-made designs in TennoGen Round 22: Part 1. Coming to Veilbreaker is Part 2. Players can look forward to all-new unique designs of Warframe Skins, Helmets, Armor, Weapon Skins and more from the talented Warframe community! You can check out what was released in Part 1 [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/tennogen-round-22-part-1]here[/url].

Prepare for the new fight. Veilbreaker is available now!

notes.title: Baro Ki’teer Cross Platform Inventory Sync Event
notes.content:
[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/fecda0029d9eb08159712facea91743b.png[/img]

[url=https://www.warframe.com/news/tennocon-2022-recap]First announced at TennoCon 2022,[/url] Baro Ki’Teer’s inventory will soon be synced across all platforms! Along with community testing happening later this year, this is a major step in fulfilling our promise to bring Cross Play to Warframe. This is the first of many steps we are taking to unify systems that are per-database timers (Relics, Vendors, etc) - more to come on that at a later date!

[b]Starting Friday July 29,[/b] Baro will visit the Earth Strata Relay and carry the same inventory regardless of what platform you’re playing on. This is especially great news for console players, as Baro’s console inventory will no longer be several weeks behind his PC manifest. As part of this change, please note that Baro’s inventory will remain the same for his next three visits, until the end of August.

To thank you for your patience, we’re excited to announce that Baro will be selling several brand new items, including an all-new Baro-themed Armor Set and Syandana, several The New War-themed Noggle Statues, and more! These items will be available each time Baro visits from now until the end of August, so you’ll have plenty of time to earn the Ducats needed to purchase everything. This is in addition to nearly 100 other items that will be available during his next three visits.

[h2]Double Resource Event Rerun[/h2]

Baro’s synced inventory won’t be the only reason to jump into the Origin System on Friday. [url=https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1316924-july-17-server-stability-resolved/]As previously announced,[/url] we’re rerunning a portion of TennoCon 2022’s Double Resource Event due to server issues some of you encountered during that weekend.

This means you now have an extra opportunity to earn double the Resources on any activity you participate in throughout the Origin System. It’s the perfect time to stock up and build that new Warframe or Weapon you’ve been eyeing!

The Double Resource Rerun will begin at 9 a.m. ET on Friday July 29 and will last 24 hours until July 30 at 9 a.m. ET

notes.title: TennoCon 2022 Recap
notes.content:
[h3]The Duviri Paradox: Winter 2022[/h3]
Coming to all platforms this Winter, The Duviri Paradox will throw you into a color-shifting landscape, unlike anything you’ve seen before.

[previewyoutube=wxbNAraWhiU;full]https://www.youtube.com/embed/wxbNAraWhiU[/previewyoutube]
Play as an outlaw known as the Drifter as you fight for a way to break free from Duviri’s endless daily cycle of death and rebirth. Complete the cinematic Quest, meet characters new and old, claim powerful upgrades and ultimately wrest control of Duviri from the clutches of the tyrant Dominus Thrax.

As you explore the color-changing mood driven landscapes of Duviri under Dominus Thrax’s control, you’ll fight Dax Guards, complete requests, solve puzzles and be rewarded with Decrees, upgrades that boost your Drifters capabilities for the duration of that day’s cycle. With the help of Teshin and with enough Decrees, the assistance of fellow Tenno and your loyal flying Kaithe mount, you may be able to challenge the fearsome Orowyrm itself.

The Duviri Paradox will take place before the events of The New War, allowing more players the ability to experience all that it has to offer. Look forward to more information about The Duviri Paradox in the coming months!

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/015979dd1bec2491210cf92a2a8e13cc.png[/img]

Players in-game got a first glimpse of The Duviri Paradox during the roughly 20-minute demo by joining us in the Duviri Amphitheater, a limited-time Relay Event that allowed Tenno to visit a slice of Duviri and explore some of the landscape along with a theatrical overview of story-driven moments.

[h3]Veilbreaker: Coming Soon[/h3]
[b]Kahl is back![/b] In Warframe’s next thrilling Quest update, you’ll take control of the heroic Grineer soldier Kahl-175. Having survived Erra’s devastation of Cetus and lifted his Narmer Veil, Kahl decides to fight for his freedom and the freedom of his Grineer brothers.

Archons also return with deadly surprises to catch you unaware. Unite with your fellow Tenno to take them down, and lift the Veil once and for all! Veilbreaker is coming soon to all platforms.

[previewyoutube=M83iuMeROQo;full]<VEILBREAKER>[/previewyoutube]
[h3]Cross Play, Cross Save and Mobile[/h3]
Warframe is continuing its path towards Cross Play, Cross Save, and mobile development as the team has spent the last year exploring Cross Play capabilities and performing internal testing.

With these steps forward comes our expansion into Community Testing and we are excited to announce that these tests will be happening this year.

In preparation for Cross Play and mobile releases, we will be synchronizing various systems starting with the Void Trader, Baro Ki’teer. Inventories will become aligned for all platforms when Baro makes his scheduled visit starting July 29, 2022.

We are still deeply committed to the implementation of Cross Play and Cross Save and we are striving to let everyone across every platform play seamlessly from wherever and whenever they choose.

[h3]Soulframe[/h3]
To close out the show, the team had one final announcement: Soulframe. Debuting with an over five-minute cinematic trailer, Soulframe is an entirely new game from Digital Extremes veterans that will feature open-world, co-op gameplay in its own independent and immersive fantasy experience.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7O95JgXgqbQ
While still in early development, Soulframe is a free-to-play Action Hybrid-MMORPG that features an entirely unique world with themes of nature, restoration and exploration. As a totally new game, Soulframe development will be transparent, collaborative and community-focused; leveraging the learning and growth over the last decade of success of Warframe.

[h3]Warframe Team Transition[/h3]
As part of the Soulframe announcement, the team also announced that Steve Sinclair and Geoff Crookes along with select Warframe developers will expand their efforts onto Soulframe. Additionally, Steve will influence the franchise direction by defining a new generation of innovative online game experiences for players and fans of both sci-fi and fantasy.

Rebecca Ford, who has been with Digital Extremes since Warframe’s beginning, and the voice of the Lotus, will be leading Warframe’s charge into the future as Creative Director. This path forward allows us to be fully confident in both Soulframe and Warframe as development continues for years to come. Our commitment is to maintain service consistency and creative innovation for the continuation of a high-quality, player-focused game. Expect more top-tier updates, beginning with Veilbreaker and The Duviri Paradox.

For more information and to read statements from both Rebecca Ford and Steve Sinclair, head over to our [url=www.warframe.com/news/Warframe-team-transition]Official News[/url].

We’ll be sharing more about Soulframe as development continues, but you can reserve your in-game name now by ‘declaring your Envoy’ at [url=https://www.soulframe.com]soulframe.com[/url].

[h3]Khora Prime Access[/h3]
The gilded huntress enters Prime Access! Revealed during The Art Panel, you can now add both mistress and monster to your Arsenal instantly as well as Khora Prime’s signature weapons and Accessories with Prime Access. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/warframeprime]Click here to find out more.[/url]
[previewyoutube=FEQP2y--LG8;full]<KHORA>[/previewyoutube]
[h3]Titania Donann Collection [/h3]
Assume a form as lustrous as midnight with the Titania Donann Collection, available now! The Titania Donann collection includes:[code]
Titania Donann Skin
Titania’s Moyturan Wings
Aerospri Dex Pixia Skin
Hawth Diwata Skin
Raylta Syandana[/code]
Pick up the Titania Donann Collection in the Market on all platforms today and take flight!

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/0f1eaae649c66c6440f6fe163f895aca.png[/img]

[h3]Joe Madureira Warframe Design Collaboration[/h3]
We’re howling with delight that Warframe is collaborating with industry titan Joe Madureira to bring the hotly requested wolf-inspired Warframe out of his imagination and into your Foundry.

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/dfa4e9ab8bbe8eb101bde4a5973c1a88.png[/img]

Best known for his work on monumental franchises like Marvel’s Uncanny X-Men, Darksiders and more, Joe is bringing his signature style to the Origin System with this upcoming Warframe.

[previewyoutube=pCc4G8DX85w;full]<AIRSHIP SYNDICATE VIDEO>[/previewyoutube]
[h3]Airship Syndicate and DE[/h3]
Also announced was a new publishing partnership between Digital Extremes and Austin-based developer Airship Syndicate!

While you may know them as the studio behind games like Darksiders Genesis, Battle Chasers: Nightwar, or The Ruined King: A League of Legends Story, DE and Airship Syndicate were first introduced through the Warframe collaboration with Joe Mad. Since then, mutual respect and a shared love of crafting worlds for players to enjoy have fostered the relationship into a full-fledged partnership.

Along with Joe Madureira, Steve Madureira, and Ryan Stefanellli, the team at Airship Syndicate is a passionate, player-focused group with a strong vision for their next project. Get introduced to the team Airship Syndicate and listen to their plans for an online action game in a tech-powered fantasy world.

Don’t miss the World Premiere at The Game Awards later this year for more info on what they’re working on! For now, however, you can join the conversation with Airship Syndicate on [url=https://twitter.com/airshipsyn?lang=en]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/airshipsyndicate/]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/airshipsyndicate/]Instagram[/url].

[h3]Styanax, The 50th Warframe[/h3]
Revealed in a teaser for an upcoming animated short, Styanax, the 50th Warframe was debuted to players at TennoLive!

Inspired by the spear and shield-wielding warriors of Earth’s distant past, Styanax evokes champions of ancient mythology. Ever valiant in the face of the foe, you can expect Styanax to never shy away from a fight.

The Animated Teaser shared at TennoLive is a small preview of an animated short, releasing as Styanax marches into the Origin System. Stay tuned for more information!

[h3]In Game Gear Still Available[/h3]
TennoCon may be finished, but you can still claim in-game items! Make sure to bullet-jump into the game and take advantage of the Double Resource Weekend on all platforms now until July 17 at 11 a.m. ET.

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/db24171ced800efdf0f4eec753c93db0.png[/img]

Don’t miss out on The Stranger’s Hood, now available in the Market for only one Credit. Act now, The Stranger’s Hood will leave the Market on July 18 at 12:30 p.m. ET.

Nightwave: Nora’s Mix - Vol. 2 launches tomorrow, July 17 at 8 p.m. ET on all platforms. Complete new Acts, earn Cred and claim incredible new Rewards! You can learn more about the upcoming Nightwave on our [url=https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1316486-nora%E2%80%99s-mix-vol2-hotfix-3164/]Official Forums[/url]!

Don’t forget about Baro, Tenno! His TennoCon Relay is still open until July 23, where you can trade Ducats for everything he’s ever sold. You’ll need a TennoCon 2022 Digital Pack to gain access, which comes with all sorts of Customizations for your Warframe and Operator as well! Get your [url=https://www.warframe.com/buyplatinum]TennoCon Digital Pack[/url] today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2000380/Warframe__Tennocon_2022_Digital_Pack/

[h3]Prime Gaming[/h3]
It’s your last chance to get the full Verv Collection free with your [url=https://gaming.amazon.com/loot/warframe]Prime Gaming account[/url]. If you have Amazon Prime, you can claim the Loki Verv Bundle, Verv Redeemer Pack and much more until August 1 at 2 p.m. ET!

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/9197b7ac49b00bf61e637769e6e9e62a.png[/img]

[h3]Custom Zariman PC [/h3]
This incredible Zariman PC could become a part of your IRL Arsenal, Tenno! All you have to do to have a chance to win is enter this [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/warframe-zariman-custom-pc-giveaway]Gleam giveaway[/url] before August 16. Some restrictions apply. 

The Zariman PC is a towering behemoth of a machine with the specs to match. It will make an excellent addition to any Tenno’s battlestation. Best of luck! (Please note: Holdfasts not included inside, we cannot confirm or deny the existence of Void Angels in the PC case.)

[h3]TENNOCON 2022 CHARITY PARTNER: Indspire[/h3]
This year, Digital Extremes is thrilled to partner with Indspire, an Indigenous-run Canadian organization working to raise the percentage of Indigenous youth entering and graduating from post-secondary educational institutions. Digital Extremes is proud to make a donation of $200,000 to support Indspire’s work. To learn more about Indspire, or make a donation yourself, visit [url=wrfr.me/indspire]wrfr.me/indspire[/url].

[h3]And if you still haven't had enough, you can watch the whole event again...[/h3]
[previewyoutube=XFwPywEaeeo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Echoes of the Zariman
notes.content:
Our first update after Angels of the Zariman (and the last before TennoCon) has arrived! Echoes of the Zariman focuses heavily on optimizing your gameplay experience with major QOL improvements and bug fixes. Stunning new Zariman-themed Evolving Weapons and Customizations are available, as well as powerful buffs with the addition of Lohk Surges in Zariman Missions. To top it all off, a summer favorite is back with Dog Days!

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/644421af8fd3b661af396dcd36020530.png[/img]

[h3]Gameplay and Feature Improvements[/h3]

When you revisit the Zariman you’ll discover a number of significant QOL enhancements! As a result of our commitment to make Angels of the Zariman the best possible experience, we’ve deployed changes based on extensive community feedback, including a reduction in Eximus Overguard, improved Void Sling mobility and much more.

You can see a full breakdown of changes and fixes made in the Echoes of the Zariman patch notes [url=https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1313506-echoes-of-the-zariman-update-316/]here.[/url]

[h3]New Tenno Reinforcements[/h3]

Cavalero has unearthed two new Incarnon Weapons previously used for ceremonial purposes: the Felarx Shotgun and the Innodem Dagger. Complete challenges to unlock their Incarnon form and Weapon upgrades!

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/af8a66244c6299c072d8167535f8257a.png[/img]

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/d5f77081131f3181ac13b0a39540cc9b.png[/img]

[h3]NEW ARCANES[/h3]

Make the most of your growing Arcane collection with five new Arcanes, and an Amp Arcane Adapter that fuses with an Amp to unlock an additional Arcane Slot.

*All values below are shown at Rank 5.

[b]Eternal Onslaught (Amps)[/b]
On Energy Depleted: +180% Critical Chance for 8s.

[b]Eternal Logistics (Amps)[/b]
On Void Sling: +72% Amp Ammo Efficiency for 8s.

[b]Molt Augmented (Warframe)[/b]
On Kill: +0.24% Ability Strength. Stacks up to 250x.

[b]Molt Reconstruct (Warframe)[/b]
Heal yourself and allies within Affinity Range 6 Health for each point of energy spent on the initial casting cost of abilities.

[b]Cascadia Flare (Secondary)[/b]
On Heat Status Effect: +12% Damage for 10s. Stacks up to 480%.

[h3]NEW CUSTOMIZATIONS[/h3]

Stylize your Arsenal with the all-new Seraphayre Ephemera and Raptwing Ephemera – both designs inspired by Void Angels and Void Energy. Purchase the Blueprints for Standing and craft them to imbue yourself with the ethereal nature of the Void.

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/0a222f5c5734a98a0776606d7d853663.png[/img]

[h3]Zariman Missions: Lohk Surges[/h3]

Experience a burst of unbridled power in Zariman Missions with new Lohk Surges that will spawn at random, and grant you short term buffs to health, energy, affinity, ammo, fire rate and more when activated! Never let your guard down, Tenno. Triggering a Lohk Surge will unleash a sinister Eximus Enemy that will test your mettle.


[h3]Dog Days Returns with New Rewards and Night Mode[/h3]

It wouldn’t be summer in the Origin System without the return of Dog Days! Cannonball your way into Missions and soak your opponents to receive a variety of refreshing Rewards, and have fun under the stars with the new day and night cycle. Dog Days begins June 9 at 2 p.m. ET and runs on all platforms until June 29 at 2 p.m. ET.

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/8b531031f3b583e81fe3d7f786ee8dfc.jpg[/img]

[b]Mission 1:[/b] 50,000 Credits and Redeemer Abysso Skin
[b]Mission 2:[/b] 50,000 Credits and Hydroid's Relay Scene
[b]Mission 3:[/b] 50,000 Credits and Hydroid Reprise Noggle
[b]Mission 4:[/b] Orokin Reactor and Stratos Emblem

Put your well-earned Nakak Pearls toward the [b]brand-new Fishy Ephemera, a Dog Days Kavat and Kubrow Glyph and a new Dog Days Night Captura scene![/b]

Echoes of the Zariman is available now on all Platforms!

TennoCon 2022 is fast approaching! On July 16, unite with your fellow Tenno from across the Origin System for a fully-digital, all-day event packed with exciting reveals from the team at Digital Extremes.

[h3]COMMUNITY ART SHOW[/h3]

This year’s Community Art Show is the perfect opportunity to showcase your art to fans and creators alike! [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/tennocon-2022-en]Submit[/url] your original Warframe-themed artwork or cosplay (pets included) before June 16 at 11:59 p.m. ET for a chance to be featured during the main event. All original submissions are welcome!

[b]Dojo Showcase[/b]

The Dojo showcase is back for another year! All past Featured Dojo Contest winners are eligible to submit to the TennoCon 2022 Dojo Showcase. Get ready for some truly epic, never-before-seen Clan creations and visit the [url=https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1309368-tennocon-2022-dojo-showcase]Official Forums[/url] for more details.

[h3]CHARITY PARTNERSHIP[/h3]

We will once again be making a donation to a Canadian charity for this year’s event! Stay tuned for more information.

We can’t wait to celebrate with you on July 16, Tenno!

notes.title: Angels of the Zariman
notes.content:
Return to where it all began and illuminate the dark mysteries lurking within the Zariman Ten Zero. Delve deep into a brand-new Quest in this highly-anticipated follow-up to The New War, featuring all-new ways to play, new enemies and more ways to customize your gear.

[previewyoutube=0n6f--mi02A;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]CHALLENGE THE VOID[/h3]

Venture into the very heart of the Zariman and explore unique locations like the Crystalith social hub. Here you can meet new characters and friends, customize your own Dormizone apartment, or jump seamlessly into three challenging new Endless Mission types—including thrilling spins on Warframe's classic four-player Missions. Be prepared, though. Mysterious and terrifying new enemies stalk the Zariman's abandoned halls.

[b]VOID FLOOD[/b]

Manage Corruption aboard the Zariman by depositing errant Vitoplast into Void Ruptures. Use parkour to traverse quickly as high Void Contamination for too long will plunge the whole area into cataclysmic instability.

[b]VOID CASCADE[/b]

Fight for Survival in the depths of the tainted Zariman, as Thrax Centurions hunt down Exolizers. Purge the Exolizers of the Void's influence and use your Warframe and Operator in tandem to eliminate Thrax Centurions and protect your beachhead against the Void.

[b]VOID ARMAGEDDON[/b]

Mount a defense against waves of enemies as you revitalize the Zariman’s decaying security grid. Build Exodampers and Armaments to damage enemies or slow their movement and dig in for a desperate fight. How long will you hold out, Tenno?

[h3]UNLEASH THE ARSENAL OF THE ZARIMAN[/h3]

You won’t be alone amidst the darkness. Take on deadly new threats with three brand-new evolving Zariman Weapons, and complete objectives to unlock powerful upgrades, including alt-fire modes.

The Zariman being a peaceful colony ship, these weapons are ceremonial, crafted from wood taken from the immense Orokin forests on Earth. However, like the Tenno themselves, time spent in proximity to the Void has corrupted these Weapons and they are ripe with the potential for change.

Complete Missions and defeat enemies to siphon the power of the Void into your Weapons, and witness them transform in the Untime’s own image!

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/0db732b0dffedaef21655ffa10454290.jpg[/img]
[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/dc3b3423a4310de3b1cf937125122990.jpg[/img]

[h3]MASTER THE ELEGANT GYRE WARFRAME[/h3]

Annihilate enemies with the conductivity of coils and transmitters and build unstoppable momentum as the 49th Warframe, Gyre. Keep her energetic playstyle in check to control the flow of any Mission and have a chance to deal critical damage for each Electrical status that affects the enemy.

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/cbc859fc9d58d19b9e637e066f7427f2.png[/img]

Wield Gyre’s Arsenal of choice with the Gyre Collection, containing the Triodic Syandana and her signature Alternox Rifle, capable of launching electric spheres at enemies or striking from a distance with a long-range lightning bolt.

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/7c945c390865e7d1b0de13c4967798b4.png[/img]

[h3]GYRE WARFRAME ABILITIES[/h3]

[b]ARCSPHERE[/b]

Launch a Gyratory Sphere that will deal high damage on impact and periodically deal electrical shocks to nearby enemies. Hit multiple enemies at once with the initial launch to enhance damage.

[b]COIL HORIZON[/b]

Throw forward a Gyratory Sphere that will implode after 2 seconds, or can be manually triggered.

[b]CATHODE GRACE[/b]

Gain a brief burst of increased Critical Chance and Energy Regen, with each kill extending duration of Cathode Grace. Casting is on a cooldown.

[b]ROTORSWELL[/b]

Gyre’s mechanisms spin at incredible speeds, generating an Electric Field that shocks nearby enemies. When Gyre gets a critical hit, a large electrical discharge will chain from the enemy that was hit to nearby enemies.

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/bd266b023348ec790feae2d3e708fb63.png[/img]

[h3]CUSTOMIZE YOUR DORMIZONE[/h3]

Carve out a personal sanctuary with brand-new Dormizones! With the help of the remaining souls left in the Chrysalith, outfit your Dormizone with Decorations and soundscapes to really make it feel like home.

Increase your Standing in the Chrysalith and you’ll even be able to unlock new rooms with stunning Vistagraphs.

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/9f3a524e933a8d70a67ebc0355bbe2b5.jpg[/img]

[h3]REINFORCE YOUR ARSENAL[/h3]

Add new Weapons, Customizations, Boosters and more to your Arsenal with new Emergence and Chrysalith Supporter Packs! Venture into the dark of the Zariman with the evolving Tenno badge of honor, the Vasero Sekhara, the striking Hespar Scythe and much more. Sekharas are adornments given to only the most accomplished Tenno, signifiers of extraordinary ability. Wear it proudly, Tenno!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/391a959c95a60a109f2c5821412609b2fa084f98.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968100/
[b]EMERGENCE PACK[/b]
[code]- Vasero Sekhara
- Hespar Scythe
- Galeforce Dawn Stance Mod
- Zariman Glyph*
- Zariman Sigil*
- 7-Day Resource Booster
- 7-Day Resource Drop Chance Booster[/code]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25748/
[b]CHRYSALITH PACK[/b]
[code]- Vasero Sekhara
- Hespar Scythe
- Galeforce Dawn Stance Mod
- Zariman Glyph*
- Zariman Sigil*
- 7-Day Resource Booster
- 7-Day Resource Drop Chance Booster
- 500 Platinum
- Gyre Warframe
- Gyre Automaton Helmet
- Gyratory Sphere Decoration
- Triodic Syandana
- Alternox Rifle
- Saryn Voidshell Skin
- Volt Voidshell Skin
- Rhino Voidshell Skin
- 18 Material Structures[/code]
*One per account. Items marked with a * will be exclusive to this pack for a limited time.

[h3]EARN VOIDSHELL ADORNMENTS[/h3]

Take your Fashion Frame to the next level with a brand-new class of Warframe and Operator Skins: Voidshell. Make the most of morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. Customize exactly the way you'd like and choose the Voidshell Material Structure that best suits you! Voidshell Skins are limited to Saryn, Volt and Rhino for now, with more Skins and Materials to come in the future!

[img]//n9e5v4d8.ssl.hwcdn.net/uploads/a722cb558a43d9f27e72bdea56dbd684.png[/img]

[h3]EMBODY VALKYR CARNIVEX[/h3]

Tear through enemies with the vicious strength of the Valkyr Carnivex Collection, featuring the Valkyr Carnivex Warframe Skin, Dreyric Fist Weapon Skin and Alastorn Armor Set.

[h3]OPERATOR FOCUS SCHOOL REWORK[/h3]

Focus Schools are receiving a total overhaul in Angels of the Zariman! The aim is to give all existing Schools a more defined identity and playstyle while giving you more options for active Abilities, instead of passive Energy Drains, as well as making combat flow between Operator and Warframe even more seamless. All Focus points will be refunded back to the school it was invested in when Angels of the Zariman launches! Learn more in our [url=https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1304698-focus-school-system-rework-a-broad-overview/]Dev Workshop[/url]

[h3]EXIMUS ENEMIES REWORK[/h3]

Eximus Enemies appear in Missions across the Origin System and the Zariman is no different. However, Angels of the Zariman is bringing big changes to the way that Eximus Enemies function to amplify their threat and boost Rewards accordingly, along with visual enhancements to be more identifiable in combat! Check out the full [url=https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1304698-focus-school-system-rework-a-broad-overview/]Dev Workshop[/url] for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/05f78adbba592a4abe2dff833ef13f876ba7577a.jpg[/img]

[h3]ANGELS OF THE ZARIMAN MERCH[/h3]

Commemorate and support the launch of Angels of the Zariman with the latest Merch Collection! Including a Gyre enamel pin and Zariman logo t-shirt, it’s an excellent addition to any Tenno’s wardrobe. Pre-order yours today at our [url=https://store.warframe.com/products/angels-of-the-zariman-collection]Official Store[/url]

[h3]THE NEW WAR FIREPOWER PACK[/h3]

Before you’re able to venture aboard the doomed Zariman Ten Zero, you’ll need to have completed The New War Quest! Get your Arsenal ready instantly with the new Firepower Pack and add a Railjack and Voidrig Necramech to your Arsenal, along with other helpful items. Take the fight to the Sentients with the biggest weaponry available in the Origin System. Find it in the in-game Market today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/230410/Warframe/

notes.title: We’re nominated for a Webby Award
notes.content:
[url=https://vote.webbyawards.com/PublicVoting#/2022/games/features/best-musicsound-design][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/1d0922f76b1d4606eafce45c84e7bf3b164f3510.png[/img][/url]

The New War was an emotional ride that left us all in complete awe. The incredible music and sound design throughout the Quest played a massive role in bringing that emotion to life, and we are thrilled that the outstanding work by our team has been recognized by the Webby Awards! We are proud to announce our nomination in the Music and Sound Design category.
 
…and you can vote for us right now, Tenno! 

[h3][url=https://vote.webbyawards.com/PublicVoting#/2022/games/features/best-musicsound-design][b]Vote here before Friday, April 22 at 2:59 AM ET.[/b][/url] [/h3]

Relive this incredible moment on YouTube, or find ‘For Narmer’ on Spotify, Apple Music and other major streaming services! 

[previewyoutube=L50II6zJy9U;full][/previewyoutube]
We cannot thank each of you Tenno enough for your support in making The New War such an incredible moment in Warframe history. We all lift together!

notes.title: Now Available: Garuda Prime Access
notes.content:
Awash in crimson and shimmering gold, Garuda Prime emerges on March 28! Add Garuda Prime, exclusive Prime Accessories, Weapons, Boosters and more with Prime Access, or earn Relics in-game to craft Garuda Prime, Nagantaka Prime and Corvas Prime in your Foundry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/921fd6788e49854da0e6a0531941c65252db1ece.png[/img]

Garuda Prime and her signature Prime gear tear through the battlefield with razor-sharp talons and sanguine bloodletting. Experience Garuda’s reworked abilities and witness the queen of gore get deadlier the more blood is spilled.

[b]Garuda Prime[/b]
White, gold and deepest scarlet, the queen of gore in full regalia.

[b]Nagantaka Prime[/b]
A golden version of Garuda’s versatile crossbow, as fashioned by the Orokin’s finest weaponsmiths. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause Bleeding, and Headshots have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda the Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through effect.

[b]Corvas Prime[/b]
Flaunting ceremonial beauty, this arch-gun flak-cannon is even more devastating than its standard issue counterpart.

[b]Exclusive Garuda Prime Glyphs[/b]

notes.title: Warframe 9th Anniversary
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978945/a32c6aefd4686328616690f58f7fa1e42ecfd969.png[/img]

It’s been [b]NINE[/b] monumental years since the awakening of the Tenno! 

In celebration of these amazing nine years and to thank all the tenacious Tenno out there — veterans, newcomers, and everyone in between — we are giving away [b]free[/b] DLC gear! The DLC will be available until April 4 at 2 p.m. ET. 

[b]How to download the DLC?[/b]
Simply visit the DLC store page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/DigitalExtremes/sale/WarframeAnniversary]here[/url], and click “download”.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1925520/Warframe_9_Year_Anniversary_Pack/]9 Year Anniversary Pack[/url][/b]
Bolster your Arsenal and prepare for any fight with the 9 Year Anniversary Pack, only available on Steam! This pack includes: 
[list]
[*] Lex Pistol
[*] Weapon Slot
[*] Stratus Pistol Skin
[/list]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/DigitalExtremes/sale/WarframeAnniversary]Check out our event page for additional items to bolster your Arsenal[/url][/b]

Jump in game to receive the new Wisp Dex Skin, plus complete weekly Alerts to earn even 
more Anniversary Rewards!

Be sure to also keep up to date with all the new and exciting things coming down the pipeline, and get ready to go back to the very beginning in our next update, Angels of the Zariman. 

Here’s the official first look:

[previewyoutube=04D4tKTKq2A;full][/previewyoutube]
From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for nine solid years of Warframe, and here’s to many more!

notes.title: Update 31.1: Echoes of War
notes.content:
Get ready for a host of changes and improvements to the Origin System in the first mainline update since last year’s debut of The New War! Update 31.1: Echoes of War introduces replayability to this epic, cinematic Quest, as well as QOL changes, new Customizations, and much more. Be sure to check out our [url=https://www.warframe.com/updates]Patch Notes[/url] and [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/devstream-159-overview]Devstream 159 Overview[/url] for additional details.

[previewyoutube=gT-AEs_kaoU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]RELIVE THE NEW WAR[/h2]

For the first time since The New War launched in December, you can now go back and replay Warframe’s biggest cinematic Quest by accessing it from your Codex! This feature allows you to experience your favorite moments all over again and push deeper into any areas left unexplored during your initial run. You’ll also be able to remake decisions and choose alternate interactions, but be advised that these new choices will [b]not[/b] impact your game post-New War – the outcomes from your first playthrough will still stand.

The New War features unique playable characters, epic Missions, and a new Sentient-Warframe hybrid named Caliban. Acquire his component Blueprints in-game to wield his overwhelming offensive Abilities and adapt to any battlefield.

[previewyoutube=a6TXpJHhsmE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]THE NEW WAR SUPPORTER PACKS[/h2]

Whether you’re deploying to the frontlines for the first time, or reliving your favorite moments, The New War Supporter Packs can give your Arsenal a stylish aesthetic makeover. For a limited time, enjoy up to 30% off evolving Armor, Warframe Skins and other exciting Customizations that feature a menacing new Sentient look! Click [url=https://www.warframe.com/news/the-new-war-supporter-packs]here[/url] for a full list of what’s included.
[list]
[*] Invasion Pack - [b]10% off[/b]
[*] Resistance Pack - [b]20% off[/b]
[*] Reckoning Pack - [b]30% off[/b]
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1840230/Warframe_The_New_War_Invasion_Pack/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24087/Warframe_The_New_War_Resistance_Bundle/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24088/Warframe_The_New_War_Reckoning_Bundle/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/4440a5d9993ca795faf780756241d96f03980986.jpg[/img]
[h2]HILDRYN EINHERI COLLECTION[/h2]

Rain death from the skies above in style! The Hildryn Einheri Collection highlights this tanky Warframe’s physicality with stunning shield-powered armaments! Features the Hildryn Einheri Skin, Blodgard Heavy Blade Skin, the beguiling Brising Syandana, plus a new look for Hildryn’s Balefire Charger.

[b]HILDRYN EINHERI SKIN[/b]
Descend from on high as the legend that Hildryn truly is. A Skin that ensures her legend will echo down the ages. Strength and glory!

[b]BLODGARD HEAVY BLADE SKIN[/b]
A master-crafted weapon, forged in fire for the hands of heroes - yet worthy of a goddess. Bestow this Skin upon any heavy blade.

[b]BRISING SYANDANA[/b]
The sun rises on the victor and sets upon the vanquished. This is how your legend is made. Adorn yourself with this exquisite Syandana, worthy of the sun herself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4437469/34351f784fd18cb98643b44498e7cad2b5a5af19.png[/img]
[h3]TENNOGEN ROUND 21: PART 1[/h3]

TennoGen Round 21: Part 1 features exciting Skins and Customizations for your Weapons and Warframes, including alluring new Skins for the ethereal Wisp! Look for your favorites in the in-game Market and add them to your Arsenal to support hard-working Tenno designers and elevate your Fashion Frame to new heights.

[b]WARFRAME SKINS[/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2257731063&searchtext=]Harrow Algalyst Skin by Goosmo[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2580380949&searchtext=]Wisp Sycorax Skin by Vulbjorn, the graphical walrus.[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2471915572&searchtext=]Wisp Celestist Skin by malaya & Awk’Q-Luz[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2343014724&searchtext=]Titania Pixialyst Skin by kakarrot2812[/url]
[/list]
[b]SYANDANAS[/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2487600066&searchtext=]Fei Syandana by malaya & Jadie[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2390682469&searchtext=]Laprosys Syandana by FrellingHazmot[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2396418848&searchtext=]Draugen Syandana by Goosmo[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2257745097&searchtext=]Eklis Syandana by Goosmo[/url]
[/list]
[b]ARMOR[/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2591666569&searchtext=]Avyrdi Shoulder Armor by led2012 & lex182[/url]
[/list]
[b]WEAPON SKINS[/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2500078680&searchtext=]Ksara Two-Handed Nikana Skin by kakarrot2812[/url]
[/list]
[h2]ADVERSARY WEAPON GENERATION QOL[/h2]

Update 31.1 introduces a new Quality of Life change designed to reduce the amount of time spent generating Progenitors (Kuva Larvlings or Sister Candidates) in search of a particular Kuva or Tenet weapon.

[b]How it works:[/b]
When you encounter a Progenitor with unwanted Weapons and opt not to mercy them, their spawned weapon is then added into a ‘reject pile’ until you go ahead and spawn an Adversary. This means that unwanted Weapons will no longer re-appear, ultimately reducing the weapon pool each time you ‘reject’ a Progenitor’s Weapon.

With this change, you’ll spend less time spawning new Progenitors, and more time blasting through foes with the powerful Kuva and Tenet Weapons of your choice!

[h2]NEW WARFRAME AUGMENTS[/h2]
Save up your Syndicate standing and give your favorite Warframes an edge in battle with powerful new Augments:

[b]Frost: Biting Frost (Passive)[/b]
Frost gains 200% Critical Chance and 200% Critical Damage against frozen enemies.

[b]Gauss: Thermal Transfer (Thermal Sunder)[/b]
Allies in range gain 75% bonus Elemental Damage for 30s.

[b]Grendel: Gourmand (Feast)[/b]
Instead of Energy, consumes 200 Health on cast and 30 Health Drain.

[b]Yareli: Surging Blades (Aquablades)[/b]
Press 3 to hurl a single Aquablade, which gains 10% damage per enemy hit by your Aquablades. No cost to throw while riding Merulina.

[h2]OTHER ADDITIONS:[/h2]

[h3]DOJO ADDITIONS[/h3]
Customize your Clan’s home base with two new Dojo Rooms, the Earth Forest Chamber and Uranus Chamber, and enjoy 100 newly-added Grineer Forest and Ocean themed Decorations, including water pumps, turbine blades, and more. Get creative and turn your Dojo into an artistic masterpiece!

[h3]NEW SOMACHORD TONES[/h3]
Three new Somachord Tones have been added to the post-New War Plains of Eidolon and Orb Vallis, featuring some of the Quest’s most-coveted musical tracks. Find them so you can re-listen whenever you’d like in your Orbiter’s Personal Quarters! Unlike the original Orb Vallis Somachord Tones, these are stationary and can always be found in the same spot.

[b]New Tones include:[/b]
[list]
[*] “For Narmer”
[*] “Hybrid Abominations”
[*] “Sunkiller”
[/list]
Relive The New War and enjoy all of the refinements that Update 31.1: Echoes of War has to offer. And if you have yet to experience The New War at all, then stop reading and check it out now!

notes.title: Warframe's New War update was shaped by pandemic trauma
notes.content:
The last several years have seen space-action MMO Warframe grow in ways that have frequently been astonishing. Since 2017, Canadian developer Digital Extremes has expanded Warframe with huge open-world zones, added ship-to-ship space combat with Railjacks, and even created zombified mechs for players to pilot into battle. The New War expansion promises to tie all of this together in the largest narrative update so far, setting Warframe up for a new era - and it's been heavily shaped by almost two years of pandemic lockdowns and isolation.

Rebecca Ford is one of the most recognisable faces of Warframe. Ford is the director of community and live operations at Digital Extremes, and she hosts the studio's regular developer streams, keeping the community updated on what's on the way for Warframe. In-game, however, she's the ever-present voice of the Lotus, the player's mysterious guide. Ford has now worked on Warframe for nine years, and says the New War is the proudest she's ever been of something the studio has made.

"I find myself looking at the depth of this quest, emotionally, creatively, collaboratively," Ford tells us. "The team has never been bigger, the team has never been through more hardships, in terms of COVID-19 and working from home, and yet somehow, throughout it all, the New War has come together. And it's taken so much inspiration from the team itself, so for me to look at it in its current state and see what we're doing, I am just so proud."

Read the rest of the story...
